\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{98}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Basic check}
Initialize the selector and draw random numbers.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{99}\moddef{Selectors: execute tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (selectors_1, "selectors_1", &
       "rng initialization and call", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{100}\moddef{Selectors: test declarations}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: selectors_1
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{101}\moddef{Selectors: tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine selectors_1 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(selector_t) :: selector
    class(rng_t), allocatable, target :: rng
    integer :: i, n

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: selectors_1"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize a selector and test it"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize selector"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call selector%init &
         ([2._default, 3.5_default, 0._default, &
         2._default, 0.5_default, 2._default])
    call selector%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Select numbers using predictable test generator"
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (rng_test_t :: rng)
    call rng%init (1)

    do i = 1, 5
       call selector%generate (rng, n)
       write (u, "(1x,I0)")  n
    end do

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Select numbers using real input number"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(1x,A,I0)")  "select(0.00) = ", selector%select (0._default)
    write (u, "(1x,A,I0)")  "select(0.77) = ", selector%select (0.77_default)
    write (u, "(1x,A,I0)")  "select(1.00) = ", selector%select (1._default)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Get weight"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(1x,A,ES19.12)")  "weight(2) =", selector%get_weight(2)
    write (u, "(1x,A,ES19.12)")  "weight(3) =", selector%get_weight(3)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call rng%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: selectors_1"

  end subroutine selectors_1

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{102}\nwdocspar
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\section{TAO Random-Number Generator}
This module provides an implementation for the generic random-number
generator.  Actually, we interface the TAO random-number generator
which is available via the VAMP package.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{103}\moddef{\code{}rng{\_}tao.f90\edoc{}}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
\LA{}File header\RA{}

module rng_tao

\LA{}Use kinds\RA{}
  use io_units
  use format_utils, only: write_indent
  use tao_random_numbers !NODEP!

  use rng_base

\LA{}Standard module head\RA{}

\LA{}RNG tao: public\RA{}

\LA{}RNG tao: types\RA{}

contains

\LA{}RNG tao: procedures\RA{}

end module rng_tao
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{104}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Generator type}
The rng object is actually the state of the random-number generator.
The methods initialize/reset and call the generator for this state.

We keep the seed, in case we want to recover it later, and count the
number of calls since seeding.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{105}\moddef{RNG tao: public}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: rng_tao_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{106}\moddef{RNG tao: types}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (rng_t) :: rng_tao_t
     integer :: seed = 0
     integer :: n_calls = 0
     type(tao_random_state) :: state
   contains
   \LA{}RNG tao: rng tao: TBP\RA{}
  end type rng_tao_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{107}Output: Display seed and number of calls.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{108}\moddef{RNG tao: rng tao: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => rng_tao_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{109}\moddef{RNG tao: procedures}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_tao_write (rng, unit, indent)
    class(rng_tao_t), intent(in) :: rng
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit, indent
    integer :: u, ind
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    ind = 0;  if (present (indent))  ind = indent
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(A)")  "TAO random-number generator:"
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(2x,A,I0)")  "seed  = ", rng%seed
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(2x,A,I0)")  "calls = ", rng%n_calls
  end subroutine rng_tao_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{110}The {\Tt{}init\nwendquote} method initializes the generator and sets a seed.
We should implement the interface such that a single integer is
sufficient for a seed.

The seed may be omitted.  The default seed is 0.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{111}\moddef{RNG tao: rng tao: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => rng_tao_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{112}\moddef{RNG tao: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_tao_init (rng, seed)
    class(rng_tao_t), intent(out) :: rng
    integer, intent(in), optional :: seed
    if (present (seed))  rng%seed = seed
    call tao_random_create (rng%state, rng%seed)
  end subroutine rng_tao_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{113}The {\Tt{}final\nwendquote} method deallocates memory where necessary and allows
for another call of {\Tt{}init\nwendquote} to reset the generator.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{114}\moddef{RNG tao: rng tao: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: final => rng_tao_final
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{115}\moddef{RNG tao: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_tao_final (rng)
    class(rng_tao_t), intent(inout) :: rng
    call tao_random_destroy (rng%state)
  end subroutine rng_tao_final

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{116}These routines generate a single and an array of default-precision
random numbers, respectively.

We have to convert from explicit double to abstract default
precision.  Under normal conditions, both are equivalent, however.
Unless, someone decides to do single precision, there is always
an interface for {\Tt{}tao{\_}random{\_}numbers\nwendquote}.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{117}\moddef{RNG tao: rng tao: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: generate_single => rng_tao_generate_single
  procedure :: generate_array => rng_tao_generate_array
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{118}\moddef{RNG tao: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_tao_generate_single (rng, x)
    class(rng_tao_t), intent(inout) :: rng
    real(default), intent(out) :: x
    real(default) :: r
    call tao_random_number (rng%state, r)
    x = r
    rng%n_calls = rng%n_calls + 1
  end subroutine rng_tao_generate_single

  subroutine rng_tao_generate_array (rng, x)
    class(rng_tao_t), intent(inout) :: rng
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: x
    real(default) :: r
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size (x)
       call tao_random_number (rng%state, r)
       x(i) = r
    end do
    rng%n_calls = rng%n_calls + size (x)
  end subroutine rng_tao_generate_array

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{119}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Factory}
This factory makes {\Tt{}rng{\_}tao{\_}t\nwendquote} generators, initialized with the seeds
\begin{equation}
  s_i = s_0 * 2^{16} + i
\end{equation}
where $s_0$ is the seed (a 16-bit integer) given to the factory
object, and $i$ is the index in the generated sequence of generators,
starting with zero.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{120}\moddef{RNG tao: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: rng_tao_factory_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{121}\moddef{RNG tao: types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (rng_factory_t) :: rng_tao_factory_t
     integer(i16) :: s = 0
     integer(i16) :: i = 0
   contains
   \LA{}RNG tao: rng tao factory: TBP\RA{}
  end type rng_tao_factory_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{122}Output.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{123}\moddef{RNG tao: rng tao factory: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => rng_tao_factory_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{124}\moddef{RNG tao: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_tao_factory_write (object, unit)
    class(rng_tao_factory_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    write (u, "(1x,A,2(I0,A))") &
         "RNG factory: tao (", object%s, ",", object%i, ")"
  end subroutine rng_tao_factory_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{125}Initialize, translating the given seed.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{126}\moddef{RNG tao: rng tao factory: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => rng_tao_factory_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{127}\moddef{RNG tao: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_tao_factory_init (factory, seed)
    class(rng_tao_factory_t), intent(out) :: factory
    integer(i16), intent(in), optional :: seed
    if (present (seed))  factory%s = seed
  end subroutine rng_tao_factory_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{128}\moddef{RNG tao: rng tao factory: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: make => rng_tao_factory_make
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{129}\moddef{RNG tao: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_tao_factory_make (factory, rng)
    class(rng_tao_factory_t), intent(inout) :: factory
    class(rng_t), intent(out), allocatable :: rng
    allocate (rng_tao_t :: rng)
    select type (rng)
    type is (rng_tao_t)
       call rng%init (factory%s * 65536 + factory%i)
       factory%i = int (factory%i + 1, kind = i16)
    end select
  end subroutine rng_tao_factory_make

\eatline

\subsubsection{Generator check}
Initialize the generator and draw random numbers.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{138}\moddef{RNG tao: execute tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (rng_tao_1, "rng_tao_1", &
       "rng initialization and call", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{139}\moddef{RNG tao: test declarations}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: rng_tao_1
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{140}\moddef{RNG tao: tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_tao_1 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    class(rng_t), allocatable, target :: rng

    real(default) :: x
    real(default), dimension(2) :: x2

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: rng_tao_1"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and call the TAO random-number &
         &generator"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize generator (default seed)"
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (rng_tao_t :: rng)
    call rng%init ()

    call rng%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Get random number"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, "(A,2(1x,F9.7))")  "x =", x

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Get random number pair"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng%generate (x2)
    write (u, "(A,2(1x,F9.7))")  "x =", x2

    write (u, "(A)")
    call rng%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call rng%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: rng_tao_1"

  end subroutine rng_tao_1

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{141}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Factory check}
Set up a factory and spawn generators.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{142}\moddef{RNG tao: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (rng_tao_2, "rng_tao_2", &
       "rng factory", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{143}\moddef{RNG tao: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: rng_tao_2
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{144}\moddef{RNG tao: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_tao_2 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(rng_tao_factory_t) :: rng_factory
    class(rng_t), allocatable :: rng
    real(default) :: x

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: rng_tao_2"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and use a rng factory"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize factory"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng_factory%init ()
    call rng_factory%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Make a generator"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng_factory%make (rng)
    call rng%write (u)
    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(1x,A,F7.5)")  "x = ", x
    call rng%final ()
    deallocate (rng)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Repeat"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng_factory%make (rng)
    call rng%write (u)
    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(1x,A,F7.5)")  "x = ", x
    call rng%final ()
    deallocate (rng)

    write (u, *)
    call rng_factory%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize factory with different seed"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng_factory%init (1_i16)
    call rng_factory%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Make a generator"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng_factory%make (rng)
    call rng%write (u)
    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(1x,A,F7.5)")  "x = ", x
    call rng%final ()
    deallocate (rng)

    write (u, *)
    call rng_factory%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: rng_tao_2"

  end subroutine rng_tao_2

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{145}\nwdocspar
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\section{RNG Stream}
We implement the RNGstream proposed and implemented in C++, C and Java by
L'Ecuyer et al. (L’Ecuyer, Pierre, Richard Simard, E. Jack Chen, and W. David
Kelton. “An Object-Oriented Random-Number Package with Many Long Streams and
Substreams.” Operations Research 50, no. 6 (December 2002): 1073–1075.
doi:10.1287/opre.50.6.1073.358.). RNGstream allows us to access multiple
independent streams of random numbers.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{146}\moddef{\code{}rng{\_}stream.f90\edoc{}}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
\LA{}File header\RA{}

module rng_stream

\LA{}Use kinds\RA{}
  use kinds, only: i16
  use io_units
  use format_utils, only: write_indent
  use diagnostics

  use rng_base

\LA{}Standard module head\RA{}

\LA{}RNG stream: parameters\RA{}

\LA{}RNG stream: public\RA{}

\LA{}RNG stream: types\RA{}

contains

\LA{}RNG stream: procedures\RA{}

end module rng_stream
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{147}We store the current position in the stream of random numbers. Furthermore, we
store the beginning of the (latest) substream and the initial starting point of
the stream, which corresponds to the ``seed''. The default seed is 1234.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{148}\moddef{RNG stream: public}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: rng_stream_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{149}\moddef{RNG stream: types}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends(rng_t) :: rng_stream_t
     private
     logical :: antithetic = .false.
     logical :: increased_precision = .false.
     real(default), dimension(3, 2) :: current_position = 1234._default
     real(default), dimension(3, 2) :: beginning_substream = 1234._default
     real(default), dimension(3, 2) :: initial_stream = 1234._default
   contains
   \LA{}RNG stream: rng stream: TBP\RA{}
  end type rng_stream_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{150}Output. Display current position and the (sub-)stream positions.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{151}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: write => rng_stream_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{152}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_write (rng, unit, indent)
    class(rng_stream_t), intent(in) :: rng
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    integer, intent(in), optional :: indent
    integer :: j, u, ind
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    ind = 0; if (present (indent)) ind = indent
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(A)") "RNG Stream generator"
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(A)") "Current position = [ "
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(3(F20.1,',',1X))") rng%current_position(:, 1)
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(3(F20.1,',',1X))") rng%current_position(:, 2)
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(A)") "]"
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(A)") "Beginning substream = [ "
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(3(F20.1,',',1X))") rng%beginning_substream(:, 1)
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(3(F20.1,',',1X))") rng%beginning_substream(:, 2)
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(A)") "]"
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(A)") "Initial stream = [ "
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(3(F20.1,',',1X))") rng%initial_stream(:, 1)
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(3(F20.1,',',1X))") rng%initial_stream(:, 2)
    call write_indent (u, ind)
    write (u, "(A)") "]"
  end subroutine rng_stream_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{153}Initialise the generator. Set the states to the (optional) seed.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{154}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: init => rng_stream_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{155}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_init (rng, seed)
    class(rng_stream_t), intent(out) :: rng
    integer, intent(in), optional :: seed
    real(default), dimension(3, 2) :: real_seed
    if (present (seed)) then
       real_seed = real(seed, default)
       call rng%set_initial_stream (real_seed)
    end if
  end subroutine rng_stream_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{156}Finalize. Nothing to do.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{157}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: final => rng_stream_final
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{158}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_final (rng)
    class(rng_stream_t), intent(inout) :: rng
  end subroutine rng_stream_final

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{159}Set the initial stream, but test the seed before. They are not allowed to be 0
or larger than $m_1$ or $m_2$.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{160}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: set_initial_stream => rng_stream_set_initial_stream
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{161}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_set_initial_stream (rng, seed)
    class(rng_stream_t), intent(inout) :: rng
    real(default), dimension(3, 2), intent(in) :: seed
    if (any (seed(:, 1) > m1)) then
       write (msg_buffer, "(A, F20.1, 1X, A)") "ERROR: seed(:, 1) >= ", m1, ",&
            & Seed is not set."
       call msg_fatal ()
    end if
    if (any (seed(:, 2) > m2)) then
       write (msg_buffer, "(A, F20.1, 1X, A)") "ERROR: seed(:, 2) >= ", m2, ",&
            & Seed is not set."
       call msg_fatal ()
    end if
    if (any (seed(:, 1) == 0)) then
       write (msg_buffer, "(A, F20.1, 1X, A)") "ERROR: First 3 seed = 0."
       call msg_fatal ()
    end if
    if (any (seed(:, 2) == 0)) then
       write (msg_buffer, "(A, F20.1, 1X, A)") "ERROR: Last 3 seed = 0."
       call msg_fatal ()
    end if
    rng%initial_stream = seed
    call rng%reset_stream ()
  end subroutine rng_stream_set_initial_stream

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{162}Generate a single real random number from the current state of (sub-)stream.

The machine representation of the result can lead to negative numbers. We add
$m_1$ or $m_2$ to the respective number to ensure they are all positive and are
still congruent to $\mod m_1$ or $\mod m_2$.

The final formula $x = y(3, 1) - y(3, 2) \pmod{m_1}$ can lead to negative random
numbers. Instead of directly calculating the modulo, we check whether $y(3,1)$
is larger than $y(3, 2)$, or not. If $x(3, 1) > y(3, 2)$, then $y(3, 1) - y(3,
2)$ is congruent to $y(3, 1) - y(3, 2) \mod{m_1}$. If $y(3, 1) < y(3, 2)$, then
$y(3, 1) - y(3, 2) + m_1$ is congruent to $y(3, 1) - y(3, 2) \mod{m_1}$.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{163}\moddef{RNG stream: parameters}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  real(default), parameter :: &
       m1 = 4294967087.0_default, &
       m2 = 4294944443.0_default, &
       norm = 1.0_default / (m1 + 1.0_default)
  real(default), dimension(3, 3), parameter :: A1p0 = reshape (&
       [0.0_default, 1.0_default, 0.0_default, &
       0.0_default, 0.0_default, 1.0_default, &
       -810728.0_default, 1403580.0_default, 0.0_default], &
       shape (A1p0), order = [2, 1])
  real(default), dimension(3, 3), parameter :: A2p0 = reshape (&
       [0.0_default, 1.0_default, 0.0_default, &
       0.0_default, 0.0_default, 1.0_default, &
       -1370589.0_default, 0.0_default, 527612.0_default], &
       shape (A2p0), order = [2, 1])
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{164}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: generate_single => rng_stream_generate_single
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{165}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_generate_single (rng, x)
    class(rng_stream_t), intent(inout) :: rng
    real(default), intent(out) :: x
    associate (y => rng%current_position)
      y(:, 1) = mod (matmul (A1p0, y(:, 1)), m1)
      if (y(3, 1) < 0.) y(3, 1) = y(3, 1) + m1
      y(:, 2) = mod (matmul (A2p0, y(:, 2)), m2)
      if (y(3, 2) < 0.) y(3, 2) = y(3, 2) + m2
      x = y(3, 1) - y(3, 2)
      if (x < 0.) x = x + m1
      x = x * norm
    end associate
    if (rng%antithetic) x = 1. - x
  end subroutine rng_stream_generate_single

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{166}Generate an array of real random numbers.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{167}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: generate_array => rng_stream_generate_array
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{168}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_generate_array (rng, x)
    class(rng_stream_t), intent(inout) :: rng
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: x
    integer :: j
    do j = 1, size (x)
       call rng%generate_single(x(j))
    end do
  end subroutine rng_stream_generate_array

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{169}Reset to initial stream.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{170}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: reset_stream => rng_stream_reset_stream
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{171}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_reset_stream (rng)
    class(rng_stream_t), intent(inout) :: rng
    rng%current_position = rng%initial_stream
    rng%beginning_substream = rng%initial_stream
  end subroutine rng_stream_reset_stream

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{172}Reset to beginning of substream.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{173}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: reset_substream => rng_stream_reset_substream
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{174}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_reset_substream (rng)
    class(rng_stream_t), intent(inout) :: rng
    rng%current_position = rng%beginning_substream
  end subroutine rng_stream_reset_substream

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{175}Advance to next substream.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{176}\moddef{RNG stream: parameters}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  real(default), dimension(3, 3), parameter :: A1p76 = reshape (&
       [82758667.0_default, 1871391091.0_default, 4127413238.0_default, &
       3672831523.0_default, 69195019.0_default, 1871391091.0_default, &
       3672091415.0_default, 352874325.0_default, 69195019.0_default], &
       shape(A1p76), order = [2, 1])
  real(default), dimension(3, 3), parameter :: A2p76 = reshape (&
       [1511326704.0_default, 3759209742.0_default, 1610795712.0_default, &
       4292754251.0_default, 1511326704.0_default, 3889917532.0_default, &
       3859662829.0_default, 4292754251.0_default, 3708466080.0_default], &
       shape(A2p76), order = [2, 1])
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{177}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: next_substream => rng_stream_next_substream
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{178}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_next_substream (rng)
    class(rng_stream_t), intent(inout) :: rng
    associate (x => rng%beginning_substream)
      x(:,1) = matmul_mod (A1p76, x(:,1), m1)
      x(:,2) = matmul_mod (A2p76, x(:,2), m2)
    end associate
    call rng%reset_substream ()
  end subroutine rng_stream_next_substream

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{179}Advance state of the current stream by $n$ steps. We do not touch the
beginning of the substream nor the initial stream. The purpose of the procedure
is to reproduce the same random number (streams) among multiple workers without
additional communication cost. E.g. worker 1 needs the first 5000 random numbers
and the second one needs the next 5000 random numbers. In such a way we can
exactly reproduce results (upon numerical noise) in single or parallel runs with
the RngStream.
The procedure must only be used with care! Misuse can lead to wrong results!
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{180}\moddef{RNG stream: parameter}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  real(default), dimension(3, 3), parameter :: A1p0 = reshape (&
       [0.0_default, 1.0_default, 0.0_default, &
       0.0_default, 0.0_default, 1.0_default, &
       -810728.0_default, 1403580.0_default, 0.0_default], &
       shape(A1p0), order = [2, 1])
  real(default), dimension(3, 3), parameter :: A2p0 = reshape (&
       [0.0_default, 1.0_default, 0.0_default, &
       0.0_default, 0.0_default, 1.0_default, &
       -1370589.0_default, 0.0_default, 527612.0_default], &
       shape(A2p0), order = [2, 1])
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{181}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: advance_state => rng_stream_advance_state
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{182}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_advance_state (rng, n)
    class(rng_stream_t), intent(inout) :: rng
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    real(default), dimension(3, 3) :: A1pn, A2pn
    associate (x => rng%current_position)
      A1pn = matpow_mod (A1p0, m1, n)
      A2pn = matpow_mod (A2p0, m2, n)
      x(:,1) = matmul_mod (A1pn, x(:,1), m1)
      x(:,2) = matmul_mod (A2pn, x(:,2), m2)
    end associate
  end subroutine rng_stream_advance_state

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{183}A divide and conquer algorithm is applied to calculate $A^n \mod{m}$.
We refer to the original paper from L'Ecuyer for further reading.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{184}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function matpow_mod (a, m, n) result (c)
    real(default), dimension(3, 3), intent(in) :: a
    real(default), intent(in) :: m
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    real(default), dimension(3, 3) :: c
    real(default), dimension(3, 3) :: w
    integer :: i
    w = a
    c = 0.; forall (i = 1:3) c(i, i) = 1.
    i = n
    do while (i > 0)
       if (mod(i, 2) /= 0) c = matmat_mod (w, c, m)
       w = matmat_mod (w, w, m)
       i = i / 2
    end do
  end function matpow_mod

  function matmat_mod (a, b, m) result (c)
    real(default), dimension(3, 3), intent(in) :: a
    real(default), dimension(3, 3), intent(in) :: b
    real(default), dimension(3, 3) :: c
    real(default), intent(in) :: m
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, 3
       c(:, i) = matmul_mod (a, b(:, i), m)
    end do
  end function matmat_mod

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{185}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Factory}
We utilize the streams proposed by L'Ecuyer where we use precalulated transition
matrices to jump between different (sub-)streams.

The random generator has the period $\rho$ and the transition function $T: s_n
\rightarrow s_{n+1}$ whereas $s_n$ is the generator's state after $n$ steps.
Furthermore, it is $T^{\rho}(s) = s$. The stream of random number then is
disjoint into streams and substreams. The length of the streams, which divide
the overall stream, should be $Z = 2^z$ and partition those streams again in $V
= 2^v$ substreams of length $W = 2^w$.

We store the seed and the initial stream, also, the beginning of the substream.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{186}\moddef{RNG stream: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: rng_stream_factory_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{187}\moddef{RNG stream: types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends(rng_factory_t) :: rng_stream_factory_t
     real(default), dimension(3, 2) :: seed = 1234._default
   contains
   \LA{}RNG stream: rng stream factory: TBP\RA{}
  end type rng_stream_factory_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{188}Output.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{189}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream factory: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: write => rng_stream_factory_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{190}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_factory_write (object, unit)
    class(rng_stream_factory_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    write (u, "(1x,A)") "RNG Stream factory"
    write (u, "(1x,A,6(F20.1,',',1X),A)") "Next seed = [ "
    write (u, "(1x,3(F20.1,',',1X))") object%seed(:, 1)
    write (u, "(1x,3(F20.1,',',1X))") object%seed(:, 2)
    write (u, "(1x,A)") "]"
  end subroutine rng_stream_factory_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{191}Initialize. Default seed is 1234. We do not check whether the seed is valid,
this is later done in {\Tt{}rng{\_}stream{\_}init\nwendquote}.

Additionally, we have to explicitly convert from {\Tt{}integer\nwendquote} to {\Tt{}real\nwendquote} because
we are using floating-point arithmetic and not integer arithemtic due to a
larger set of number in the representation of real numbers.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{192}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream factory: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: init => rng_stream_factory_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{193}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_factory_init (factory, seed)
    class(rng_stream_factory_t), intent(out) :: factory
    integer(i16), intent(in), optional :: seed
    real(default), dimension(3, 2) :: real_seed
    if (present (seed)) then
       factory%seed = real(seed, default)
    end if
  end subroutine rng_stream_factory_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{194}Allocate a new RNG and different stream states, accordingly.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{195}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream factory: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, public :: make => rng_stream_factory_make
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{196}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_factory_make (factory, rng)
    class(rng_stream_factory_t), intent(inout) :: factory
    class(rng_t), intent(out), allocatable :: rng
    allocate (rng_stream_t :: rng)
    select type (rng)
    type is (rng_stream_t)
       call rng%init ()
       call rng%set_initial_stream (factory%seed)
    end select
    call factory%advance_seed ()
  end subroutine rng_stream_factory_make

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{197}Advance seed. Use the precalculated transistion matrices for the streams.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{198}\moddef{RNG stream: parameters}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
real(default), dimension(3,3), parameter :: A1p127 = reshape (&
     [2427906178.0_default, 3580155704.0_default, 949770784.0_default, &
     226153695.0_default, 1230515664.0_default, 3580155704.0_default, &
     1988835001.0_default, 986791581.0_default, 1230515664.0_default], &
     shape(A1p127), order = [2, 1])
real(default), dimension(3,3), parameter :: A2p127 = reshape (&
     [1464411153.0_default, 277697599.0_default, 1610723613.0_default, &
     32183930.0_default, 1464411153.0_default, 1022607788.0_default, &
     2824425944.0_default, 32183930.0_default, 2093834863.0_default], &
     shape(A2p127), order = [2, 1])
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{199}\moddef{RNG stream: rng stream factory: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure, private :: advance_seed => rng_stream_factory_advance_seed
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{200}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_factory_advance_seed (factory)
    class(rng_stream_factory_t), intent(inout) :: factory
    factory%seed(:,1) = matmul_mod (A1p127, factory%seed(:,1), m1)
    factory%seed(:,2) = matmul_mod (A2p127, factory%seed(:,2), m2)
  end subroutine rng_stream_factory_advance_seed

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{201}Matrix modulo calculation optimized for $2^{53}$ representation of floating
numbers. Speed efficiency is not a requirement, because the streams should not
be advanced that often.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{202}\moddef{RNG stream: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  private :: matmul_mod
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{203}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function matmul_mod (a, u, m) result (v)
    real(default), dimension(:, :), intent(in) :: a
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: u
    real(default), intent(in) :: m
    real(default), dimension(size (u)) :: v
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, 3
       v(i) = mult_mod (a(i, 1), u(1), 0.0_default, m)
       v(i) = mult_mod (a(i, 2), u(2), v(i), m)
       v(i) = mult_mod (a(i, 3), u(3), v(i), m)
    end do
  end function matmul_mod

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{204}Decompose.

Decomposition to ensure exact accuracy for the case $v$ exceeds $2^{53}$.
\begin{equation*}
a \cdot s mod m = ((a1 \cdot s \mod{m}) * 2^{17} + a2 \cdot s) \mod{m}.
\end{equation*}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{205}\moddef{RNG stream: parameters}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  real(default), parameter :: &
       a12 = 1403580.0_default, &
       a13n = 810728.0_default, &
       a21 = 527612.0_default, &
       a23n = 1370589.0_default, &
       two53 = 9007199254740992.0_default, &
       two17 = 131072.0_default
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{206}\moddef{RNG stream: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  private :: mult_mod
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{207}\moddef{RNG stream: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function mult_mod (a, b, c, m) result (v)
    real(default), intent(in) :: a
    real(default), intent(in) :: b
    real(default), intent(in) :: c
    real(default), intent(in) :: m
    real(default) :: v
    integer :: a1
    real(default) :: a2
    v = a * b + c
    if (v >= two53 .or. v <= -two53) then
       a1 = int (a / two17)
       a2 = a - a1 * two17
       v = mod (a1 * b, m)
       v = v * two17 + a2 * b + c
    end if
    v = mod (v, m)
    if (v < 0.0) v = v + m
  end function mult_mod

\eatline

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{215}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Generator check}
Initialize the generator and draw random numbers.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{216}\moddef{RNG stream: execute tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (rng_stream_1, "rng_stream_1", &
       "rng initialization and call", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{217}\moddef{RNG stream: test declarations}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: rng_stream_1
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{218}\moddef{RNG stream: tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_1 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    class(rng_t), allocatable, target :: rng

    real(default) :: x
    real(default), dimension(2) :: x2

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: rng_stream_1"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and call the RNGstream random-number &
         &generator"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize generator (default seed)"
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (rng_stream_t :: rng)
    call rng%init ()

    call rng%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Get random number"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, "(A,2(1x,F9.7))")  "x =", x

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Get random number pair"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng%generate (x2)
    write (u, "(A,2(1x,F9.7))")  "x =", x2

    write (u, "(A)")
    call rng%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Jump to next substream and get random number"
    write (u, "(A)")

    select type (rng)
    type is (rng_stream_t)
       call rng%next_substream ()
    end select
    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, "(A,2(1x,F9.7))")  "x =", x

    write (u, "(A)")
    call rng%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call rng%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: rng_stream_1"

  end subroutine rng_stream_1

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{219}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Factory check}
Set up a factory and spawn generators.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{220}\moddef{RNG stream: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (rng_stream_2, "rng_stream_2", &
       "rng factory", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{221}\moddef{RNG stream: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: rng_stream_2
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{222}\moddef{RNG stream: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_2 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(rng_stream_factory_t) :: rng_factory
    class(rng_t), allocatable :: rng
    real(default) :: x

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: rng_stream_2"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and use a rng factory"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize factory"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng_factory%init ()
    call rng_factory%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Make a generator"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng_factory%make (rng)
    call rng%write (u)
    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(1x,A,F7.5)")  "x = ", x
    call rng%final ()
    deallocate (rng)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Repeat"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng_factory%make (rng)
    call rng%write (u)
    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(1x,A,F7.5)")  "x = ", x
    call rng%final ()
    deallocate (rng)

    write (u, *)
    call rng_factory%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize factory with different seed"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng_factory%init (1_i16)
    call rng_factory%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Make a generator"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng_factory%make (rng)
    call rng%write (u)
    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(1x,A,F7.5)")  "x = ", x
    call rng%final ()
    deallocate (rng)

    write (u, *)
    call rng_factory%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: rng_stream_2"

  end subroutine rng_stream_2

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{223}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{RNG Stream extension}
Initialize the generator and advance state by 15389 steps and compare with
regular advanced stream position.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{224}\moddef{RNG stream: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (rng_stream_3, "rng_stream_3", &
       "rng initialization and advance state", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{225}\moddef{RNG stream: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: rng_stream_3
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{226}\moddef{RNG stream: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine rng_stream_3 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    class(rng_t), allocatable, target :: rng

    integer :: i
    real(default) :: x
    real(default), dimension(2) :: x2

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: rng_stream_3"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and advance the state of the random-number &
         &generator"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize generator (default seed)"
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (rng_stream_t :: rng)
    call rng%init ()

    call rng%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Advance state by 15389 by iteration"
    write (u, "(A)")

    do i = 1, 15389
       call rng%generate (x)
    end do

    call rng%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Get random number"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, "(A,2(1x,F9.7))")  "x =", x

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Advance state by 15389 by procedure"
    write (u, "(A)")

    select type (rng)
    type is (rng_stream_t)
       call rng%reset_substream ()
       call rng%advance_state (15389)
    end select

    call rng%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Get random number"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, "(A,2(1x,F9.7))")  "x =", x


    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Get random number pair"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call rng%generate (x2)
    write (u, "(A,2(1x,F9.7))")  "x =", x2

    write (u, "(A)")
    call rng%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Jump to next substream and get random number"
    write (u, "(A)")

    select type (rng)
    type is (rng_stream_t)
       call rng%next_substream ()
    end select
    call rng%generate (x)
    write (u, "(A,2(1x,F9.7))")  "x =", x

    write (u, "(A)")
    call rng%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call rng%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: rng_stream_3"

  end subroutine rng_stream_3

\eatline

module dispatch_rng

  use kinds, only: i16
\LA{}Use strings\RA{}
  use diagnostics
  use variables

  use rng_base
  use rng_tao
  use rng_stream

\LA{}Standard module head\RA{}

\LA{}Dispatch rng: public\RA{}

\LA{}Dispatch rng: variables\RA{}

contains

\LA{}Dispatch rng: procedures\RA{}

end module dispatch_rng
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{230}Allocate a random-number generator factory according to the variable
{\Tt{}{\$}rng{\_}method\nwendquote}, using the current seed in the global record.  We take
only the lower 15 bits of the seed, so the actual value fits into a
positive 16-bit signed integer.

Since we want to guarantee that all random-number generators in a run
are independent, we increment the global seed by one after creating
the rng factory.  If the user wants to have identical sequences, he
can always set the seed manually, before it is used.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{231}\moddef{Dispatch rng: public}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: dispatch_rng_factory
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{232}\moddef{Dispatch rng: procedures}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine dispatch_rng_factory (rng_factory, var_list_global, var_list_local)
    class(rng_factory_t), allocatable, intent(inout) :: rng_factory
    type(var_list_t), intent(inout) :: var_list_global
    type(var_list_t), intent(in), optional :: var_list_local
    type(var_list_t) :: local
    type(string_t) :: rng_method
    integer :: seed
    character(30) :: buffer
    integer(i16) :: s
    if (present (var_list_local)) then
       local = var_list_local
    else
       local = var_list_global
    end if
    rng_method = local%get_sval (var_str ("$rng_method"))
    seed = local%get_ival (var_str ("seed"))
    s = int (mod (seed, 32768), i16)
    select case (char (rng_method))
    case ("tao")
       allocate (rng_tao_factory_t :: rng_factory)
       call msg_message ("RNG: Initializing TAO random-number generator")
    case ("rng_stream")
       allocate (rng_stream_factory_t :: rng_factory)
       call msg_message ("RNG: Initializing RNG Stream random-number generator")
    case default
       if (associated (dispatch_rng_factory_extra)) then
          call dispatch_rng_factory_extra (rng_factory, var_list_global, var_list_local)
       end if
       if (.not. allocated (rng_factory)) then
          call msg_fatal ("Random-number generator '" &
               // char (rng_method) // "' not implemented")
       end if
    end select
    write (buffer, "(I0)")  s
    call msg_message ("RNG: Setting seed for random-number generator to " &
            // trim (buffer))
    call rng_factory%init (s)
    call var_list_global%set_int (var_str ("seed"), seed + 1, &
         is_known = .true.)
  end subroutine dispatch_rng_factory

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{233}This is a hook that allows us to inject further handlers for
RNG factory objects, in particular a test RNG.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{234}\moddef{Dispatch rng: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: dispatch_rng_factory_extra
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{235}\moddef{Dispatch rng: variables}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure (dispatch_rng_factory), pointer :: &
       dispatch_rng_factory_extra => null ()
\eatline

\subsubsection{Select type: random number generator}
This is an extra dispatcher that enables the test RNG.  This procedure
should be assigned to the {\Tt{}dispatch{\_}rng{\_}factory{\_}extra\nwendquote} hook before
any tests are executed.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{245}\moddef{Dispatch rng: public test auxiliary}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: dispatch_rng_factory_test
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{246}\moddef{Dispatch rng: test auxiliary}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine dispatch_rng_factory_test (rng_factory, var_list_global, var_list_local)
    use rng_base
    use rng_base_ut, only: rng_test_factory_t
    class(rng_factory_t), allocatable, intent(inout) :: rng_factory
    type(var_list_t), intent(inout) :: var_list_global
    type(var_list_t), intent(in), optional :: var_list_local
    type(var_list_t) :: local
    type(string_t) :: rng_method
    if (present (var_list_local)) then
       local = var_list_local
    else
       local = var_list_global
    end if
    rng_method = &
         local%get_sval (var_str ("$rng_method"))
    select case (char (rng_method))
    case ("unit_test")
       allocate (rng_test_factory_t :: rng_factory)
       call msg_message ("RNG: Initializing Test random-number generator")
    end select
  end subroutine dispatch_rng_factory_test

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{247}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{248}\moddef{Dispatch rng: execute tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (dispatch_rng_1, "dispatch_rng_1", &
       "random-number generator", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{249}\moddef{Dispatch rng: test declarations}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: dispatch_rng_1
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{250}\moddef{Dispatch rng: tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine dispatch_rng_1 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(var_list_t) :: var_list
    class(rng_factory_t), allocatable :: rng_factory

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: dispatch_rng_1"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: select random-number generator"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call var_list%init_defaults (0)

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Allocate RNG factory as rng_test_factory_t"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call var_list%set_string (&
         var_str ("$rng_method"), &
         var_str ("unit_test"), is_known = .true.)
    call var_list%set_int (&
         var_str ("seed"), 1, is_known = .true.)
    call dispatch_rng_factory (rng_factory, var_list)
    call rng_factory%write (u)
    deallocate (rng_factory)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Allocate RNG factory as rng_tao_factory_t"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call var_list%set_string (&
         var_str ("$rng_method"), &
         var_str ("tao"), is_known = .true.)
    call dispatch_rng_factory (rng_factory, var_list)
    call rng_factory%write (u)
    deallocate (rng_factory)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Allocate RNG factory as rng_stream_factory_t"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call var_list%set_string (&
         var_str ("$rng_method"), &
         var_str ("rng_stream"), is_known = .true.)
    call dispatch_rng_factory (rng_factory, var_list)
    call rng_factory%write (u)
    deallocate (rng_factory)

    call var_list%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: dispatch_rng_1"

  end subroutine dispatch_rng_1

\eatline

\nwenddocs{}\nwfilename{../../../src/physics/physics.nw}\nwbegindocs{0}% -*- ess-noweb-default-code-mode: f90-mode; noweb-default-code-mode: f90-mode; -*-
% WHIZARD code as NOWEB source: physics and such
\chapter{Physics}
\includemodulegraph{physics}

Here we collect definitions and functions that we need for (particle)
physics in general, to make them available for the more specific needs
of WHIZARD.
\begin{description}
\item[physics\_defs]
  Physical constants.
\item[c\_particles]
  A simple data type for particles which is C compatible.
\item[lorentz]
  Define three-vectors, four-vectors and Lorentz
  transformations and common operations for them.
\item[sm\_physics]
  Here, running functions are stored for special kinematical setup like
  running coupling constants, Catani-Seymour dipoles, or Sudakov factors.
\item[sm\_qcd]
  Definitions and methods for dealing with the running QCD coupling.
\item[shower\_algorithms]
  Algorithms typically used in Parton Showers as well as in their
  matching to NLO computations, e.g. with the POWHEG method.
\end{description}

\clearpage

\subsection{Spin codes}
Somewhat redundant, but for better readability we define named
constants for spin types.  If the mass is nonzero, this is equal to
the number of degrees of freedom.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{37}\moddef{Physics defs: public parameters}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  integer, parameter, public:: UNKNOWN = 0
  integer, parameter, public :: SCALAR = 1, SPINOR = 2, VECTOR = 3, &
                                VECTORSPINOR = 4, TENSOR = 5

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{38}Isospin types and charge types are counted in an analogous way,
where charge type 1 is charge 0, 2 is charge 1/3, and so on. Zero
always means unknown. Note that charge and isospin types have an
explicit sign.

Color types are defined as the dimension of the representation.

\subsection{NLO status codes}
Used to specify whether a {\Tt{}term{\_}instance{\_}t\nwendquote} of a
{\Tt{}process{\_}instance{\_}t\nwendquote} is associated with a Born, real-subtracted,
virtual-subtracted or subtraction-dummy matrix element.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{39}\moddef{Physics defs: public parameters}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  integer, parameter, public :: BORN = 0
  integer, parameter, public :: NLO_REAL = 1
  integer, parameter, public :: NLO_VIRTUAL = 2
  integer, parameter, public :: NLO_MISMATCH = 3
  integer, parameter, public :: NLO_DGLAP = 4
  integer, parameter, public :: NLO_SUBTRACTION = 5
  integer, parameter, public :: NLO_FULL = 6
  integer, parameter, public :: GKS = 7
  integer, parameter, public :: COMPONENT_UNDEFINED = 99

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{40}% def BORN, NLO_REAL, NLO_VIRTUAL, NLO_SUBTRACTION, GKS
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegindocs{41}{\Tt{}NLO{\_}FULL\nwendquote} is not strictly a component status code but having it is
convenient.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{42}\moddef{Physics defs: public}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: component_status
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{43}\moddef{Physics defs: interfaces}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  interface component_status
     module procedure component_status_of_string
     module procedure component_status_to_string
  end interface
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{44}\moddef{Physics defs: procedures}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  elemental function component_status_of_string (string) result (i)
    integer :: i
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: string
    select case (char(string))
    case ("Born")
       i = BORN
    case ("Real")
       i = NLO_REAL
    case ("Virtual")
       i = NLO_VIRTUAL
    case ("Mismatch")
       i = NLO_MISMATCH
    case ("Dglap")
       i = NLO_DGLAP
    case ("Subtraction")
       i = NLO_SUBTRACTION
    case ("Full")
       i = NLO_FULL
    case ("GKS")
       i = GKS
    case default
       i = COMPONENT_UNDEFINED
    end select
  end function component_status_of_string

  elemental function component_status_to_string (i) result (string)
    type(string_t) :: string
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    select case (i)
    case (BORN)
       string = "Born"
    case (NLO_REAL)
       string = "Real"
    case (NLO_VIRTUAL)
       string = "Virtual"
    case (NLO_MISMATCH)
       string = "Mismatch"
    case (NLO_DGLAP)
       string = "Dglap"
    case (NLO_SUBTRACTION)
       string = "Subtraction"
    case (NLO_FULL)
       string = "Full"
    case (GKS)
       string = "GKS"
    case default
       string = "Undefined"
    end select
  end function component_status_to_string

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{45}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{46}\moddef{Physics defs: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: is_nlo_component
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{47}\moddef{Physics defs: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  elemental function is_nlo_component (comp) result (is_nlo)
    logical :: is_nlo
    integer, intent(in) :: comp
    select case (comp)
    case (BORN : GKS)
       is_nlo = .true.
    case default
       is_nlo = .false.
    end select
  end function is_nlo_component

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{48}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{49}\moddef{Physics defs: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: is_subtraction_component
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{50}\moddef{Physics defs: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function is_subtraction_component (emitter, nlo_type) result (is_subtraction)
    logical :: is_subtraction
    integer, intent(in) :: emitter, nlo_type
    is_subtraction = nlo_type == NLO_REAL .and. emitter < 0
  end function is_subtraction_component

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{51}\nwdocspar

Some commonly used variables for the threshold computation
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{52}\moddef{Physics defs: public parameters}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  integer, parameter, public :: THR_POS_WP = 3
  integer, parameter, public :: THR_POS_WM = 4
  integer, parameter, public :: THR_POS_B = 5
  integer, parameter, public :: THR_POS_BBAR = 6
  integer, parameter, public :: THR_POS_GLUON = 7

  integer, parameter, public :: FACTORIZATION_THRESHOLD = 1

  integer, dimension(2), parameter, public :: ass_boson = [3, 4]

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{53}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegindocs{54}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{55}\moddef{Physics defs: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\section{C-compatible Particle Type}
For easy communication with C code, we introduce a simple C-compatible
type for particles.   The components are either default C integers or
default C doubles.

The {\Tt{}c{\_}prt\nwendquote} type is transparent, and its contents should be regarded
as part of the interface.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{58}\moddef{\code{}c{\_}particles.f90\edoc{}}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
\LA{}File header\RA{}

module c_particles

  use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding !NODEP!

  use io_units
  use format_defs, only: FMT_14, FMT_19

\LA{}Standard module head\RA{}

\LA{}C Particles: public\RA{}

\LA{}C Particles: types\RA{}

contains

\LA{}C Particles: procedures\RA{}
end module c_particles
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{59}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{60}\moddef{C Particles: public}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: c_prt_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{61}\moddef{C Particles: types}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, bind(C) :: c_prt_t
     integer(c_int) :: type = 0
     integer(c_int) :: pdg = 0
     integer(c_int) :: polarized = 0
     integer(c_int) :: h = 0
     real(c_double) :: pe = 0
     real(c_double) :: px = 0
     real(c_double) :: py = 0
     real(c_double) :: pz = 0
     real(c_double) :: p2 = 0
  end type c_prt_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{62}This is for debugging only, there is no C binding.  It is a
simplified version of {\Tt{}prt{\_}write\nwendquote}.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{63}\moddef{C Particles: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: c_prt_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{64}\moddef{C Particles: procedures}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine c_prt_write (prt, unit)
    type(c_prt_t), intent(in) :: prt
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit);  if (u < 0)  return
    write (u, "(1x,A)", advance="no")  "prt("
    write (u, "(I0,':')", advance="no")  prt%type
    if (prt%polarized /= 0) then
       write (u, "(I0,'/',I0,'|')", advance="no")  prt%pdg, prt%h
    else
       write (u, "(I0,'|')", advance="no") prt%pdg
    end if
    write (u, "(" // FMT_14 // ",';'," // FMT_14 // ",','," // &
         FMT_14 // ",','," // FMT_14 // ")", advance="no") &
         prt%pe, prt%px, prt%py, prt%pz
    write (u, "('|'," // FMT_19 // ")", advance="no")  prt%p2
    write (u, "(A)")  ")"
  end subroutine c_prt_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{65}\nwdocspar
