\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{566}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Process definition list}
A list of process definitions is the starting point for creating a
process library.  The list is built when reading the user input.  When
reading an existing process library, the list is used for
cross-checking and updating the configuration.

We need a type for the list entry.  The simplest way is to extend the
process definition type, so all methods apply to the process
definition directly.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{567}\moddef{Process libraries: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: process_def_entry_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{568}\moddef{Process libraries: types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (process_def_t) :: process_def_entry_t
     private
     type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: next => null ()
  end type process_def_entry_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{569}This is the type for the list itself.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{570}\moddef{Process libraries: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: process_def_list_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{571}\moddef{Process libraries: types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type :: process_def_list_t
     private
     type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: first => null ()
     type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: last => null ()
   contains
   \LA{}Process libraries: process def list: TBP\RA{}
  end type process_def_list_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{572}The deallocates the list iteratively.  We assume that the list
entries do not need finalization themselves.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{573}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: final => process_def_list_final
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{574}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_def_list_final (list)
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(inout) :: list
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    nullify (list%last)
    do while (associated (list%first))
       current => list%first
       list%first => current%next
       deallocate (current)
    end do
  end subroutine process_def_list_final

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{575}Write the complete list.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{576}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => process_def_list_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{577}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_def_list_write (object, unit, libpath)
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: libpath
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: entry
    integer :: i, u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    if (associated (object%first)) then
       i = 1
       entry => object%first
       do while (associated (entry))
          write (u, "(1x,A,I0,A)")  "Process #", i, ":"
          call entry%write (u)
          i = i + 1
          entry => entry%next
          if (associated (entry))  write (u, *)
       end do
    else
       write (u, "(1x,A)")  "Process definition list: [empty]"
    end if
  end subroutine process_def_list_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{578}Short account.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{579}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: show => process_def_list_show
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{580}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_def_list_show (object, unit)
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: entry
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    if (associated (object%first)) then
       write (u, "(2x,A)")  "Processes:"
       entry => object%first
       do while (associated (entry))
          call entry%show (u)
          entry => entry%next
       end do
    else
       write (u, "(2x,A)")  "Processes: [empty]"
    end if
  end subroutine process_def_list_show

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{581}Read the complete list.  We need an array of templates for the
component subobjects of abstract {\Tt{}prc{\_}core{\_}t\nwendquote} type, to
allocate them with the correct specific type.

NOTE: Error handling is missing.  Reading will just be aborted on
error, or an I/O error occurs.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{582}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: read => process_def_list_read
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{583}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_def_list_read (object, unit, core_def_templates)
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(out) :: object
    integer, intent(in) :: unit
    type(prc_template_t), dimension(:), intent(in) :: core_def_templates
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: entry
    character(80) :: buffer, ref
    integer :: i
    read (unit, "(A)")  buffer
    write (ref, "(1x,A)")  "Process definition list: [empty]"
    if (buffer == ref)  return         ! OK: empty library
    backspace (unit)
    READ_ENTRIES: do i = 1, huge (0)
       if (i > 1) read (unit, *, end=1)
       read (unit, "(A)")  buffer

       write (ref, "(1x,A,I0,A)")  "Process #", i, ":"
       if (buffer /= ref)  return      ! Wrong process header: done.
       allocate (entry)
       call entry%read (unit, core_def_templates)
       call object%append (entry)
    end do READ_ENTRIES
1   continue                           ! EOF: done
  end subroutine process_def_list_read

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{584}Append an entry to the list.  The entry should be allocated as a
pointer, and the pointer allocation is transferred.  The original
pointer is returned null.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{585}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: append => process_def_list_append
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{586}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_def_list_append (list, entry)
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(inout) :: list
    type(process_def_entry_t), intent(inout), pointer :: entry
    if (list%contains (entry%id)) then
       call msg_fatal ("Recording process: '" // char (entry%id) &
            // "' has already been defined")
    end if
    if (associated (list%first)) then
       list%last%next => entry
    else
       list%first => entry
    end if
    list%last => entry
    entry => null ()
  end subroutine process_def_list_append

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{587}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Probe the process definition list}
Return the number of processes supported by the library.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{588}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_n_processes => process_def_list_get_n_processes
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{589}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_def_list_get_n_processes (list) result (n)
    integer :: n
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    n = 0
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       n = n + 1
       current => current%next
    end do
  end function process_def_list_get_n_processes

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{590}Allocate an array with the process IDs supported by the library.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{591}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_process_id_list => process_def_list_get_process_id_list
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{592}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_def_list_get_process_id_list (list, id)
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), dimension(:), allocatable, intent(out) :: id
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    integer :: i
    allocate (id (list%get_n_processes ()))
    i = 0
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       i = i + 1
       id(i) = current%id
       current => current%next
    end do
  end subroutine process_def_list_get_process_id_list

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{593}Return true if a given process is in the library.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{594}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: contains => process_def_list_contains
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{595}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_def_list_contains (list, id) result (flag)
    logical :: flag
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       if (id == current%id) then
          flag = .true.;  return
       end if
       current => current%next
    end do
    flag = .false.
  end function process_def_list_contains

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{596}Return the index of the entry that corresponds to a given process.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{597}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_entry_index => process_def_list_get_entry_index
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{598}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_def_list_get_entry_index (list, id) result (n)
    integer :: n
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    n = 0
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       n = n + 1
       if (id == current%id) then
          return
       end if
       current => current%next
    end do
    n = 0
  end function process_def_list_get_entry_index

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{599}Return the numerical ID for a process.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{600}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_num_id => process_def_list_get_num_id
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{601}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_def_list_get_num_id (list, id) result (num_id)
    integer :: num_id
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       if (id == current%id) then
          num_id = current%num_id
          return
       end if
       current => current%next
    end do
    num_id = 0
  end function process_def_list_get_num_id

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{602}Return the model name for a given process in the library.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{603}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_model_name => process_def_list_get_model_name
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{604}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_def_list_get_model_name (list, id) result (model_name)
    type(string_t) :: model_name
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       if (id == current%id) then
          model_name = current%model_name
          return
       end if
       current => current%next
    end do
    model_name = ""
  end function process_def_list_get_model_name

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{605}Return the number of incoming particles of a given process in the library.
This tells us whether the process is a decay or a scattering.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{606}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_n_in => process_def_list_get_n_in
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{607}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_def_list_get_n_in (list, id) result (n)
    integer :: n
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       if (id == current%id) then
          n = current%n_in
          return
       end if
       current => current%next
    end do
  end function process_def_list_get_n_in

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{608}Return the incoming particle pdg codesnumber of incoming particles
of a given process in the library.  If there is a PDG array, return
only the first code for each beam.  This serves as a quick way
for (re)constructing beam properties.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{609}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_pdg_in_1 => process_def_list_get_pdg_in_1
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{610}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_def_list_get_pdg_in_1 (list, id, pdg)
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    integer, dimension(:), intent(out) :: pdg
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       if (id == current%id) then
          call current%get_pdg_in_1 (pdg)
          return
       end if
       current => current%next
    end do
  end subroutine process_def_list_get_pdg_in_1

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{611}Return the number of components of a given process in the library.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{612}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_n_components => process_def_list_get_n_components
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{613}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_def_list_get_n_components (list, id) result (n)
    integer :: n
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       if (id == current%id) then
          n = current%n_initial + current%n_extra
          return
       end if
       current => current%next
    end do
  end function process_def_list_get_n_components

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{614}Return a pointer to a specific process component definition.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{615}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_component_def_ptr => process_def_list_get_component_def_ptr
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{616}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_def_list_get_component_def_ptr (list, id, i) result (ptr)
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    type(process_component_def_t), pointer :: ptr
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    ptr => null ()
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       if (id == current%id) then
          if (i <= current%n_initial) then
             ptr => current%initial(i)
          else if (i <= current%n_initial + current%n_extra) then
             ptr => current%extra(i-current%n_initial)
          end if
          return
       end if
       current => current%next
    end do
  end function process_def_list_get_component_def_ptr

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{617}Return the list of component IDs of a given process in the library.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{618}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_component_list => process_def_list_get_component_list
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{619}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_def_list_get_component_list (list, id, cid)
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    type(string_t), dimension(:), allocatable, intent(out) :: cid
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    integer :: i, n
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       if (id == current%id) then
          allocate (cid (current%n_initial + current%n_extra))
          do i = 1, current%n_initial
             cid(i) = current%initial(i)%basename
          end do
          n = current%n_initial
          do i = 1, current%n_extra
             cid(n + i) = current%extra(i)%basename
          end do
          return
       end if
       current => current%next
    end do
  end subroutine process_def_list_get_component_list

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{620}Return the list of component description strings for a given process
in the library.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{621}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_component_description_list => &
       process_def_list_get_component_description_list
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{622}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_def_list_get_component_description_list &
       (list, id, description)
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    type(string_t), dimension(:), allocatable, intent(out) :: description
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    integer :: i, n
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
       if (id == current%id) then
          allocate (description (current%n_initial + current%n_extra))
          do i = 1, current%n_initial
             description(i) = current%initial(i)%description
          end do
          n = current%n_initial
          do i = 1, current%n_extra
             description(n + i) = current%extra(i)%description
          end do
          return
       end if
       current => current%next
    end do
  end subroutine process_def_list_get_component_description_list

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{623}Return whether the entry corresponds to an NLO-process
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{624}\moddef{Process libraries: process def list: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_nlo_process => process_def_list_get_nlo_process
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{625}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_def_list_get_nlo_process (list, id) result (nlo)
    class(process_def_list_t), intent(in) :: list
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    logical :: nlo
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: current
    current => list%first
    do while (associated (current))
      if (id == current%id) then
        nlo = current%nlo_process
        return
      end if
      current => current%next
    end do
  end function process_def_list_get_nlo_process

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{626}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Process library}
The process library object is the interface between the process
definition data, as provided by the user, generated or linked process
code on file, and the process run data that reference the process
code.

\subsubsection{Process library entry}
For each process component that is part of the library, there is a
separate library entry ({\Tt{}process{\_}library{\_}entry{\_}t\nwendquote}.  The library
entry connects a process definition with the specific code (if any) in
the compiled driver library.

The {\Tt{}status\nwendquote} indicates how far the process has been
processed by the system (definition, code generation, compilation,
linking).  A process with status {\Tt{}STAT{\_}LOADED\nwendquote} is accessible for
computing matrix elements.

The {\Tt{}def\nwendquote} pointer identifies the corresponding process definition.
The process component within that definition is identified by the
{\Tt{}i{\_}component\nwendquote} index.

The {\Tt{}i{\_}external\nwendquote} index refers to the compiled library driver.  If it is zero,
there is no associated matrix-element code.

The {\Tt{}driver\nwendquote} component holds the pointers to the matrix-element
specific functions, in particular the matrix element function itself.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{627}\moddef{Process libraries: types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type :: process_library_entry_t
     private
     integer :: status = STAT_UNKNOWN
     type(process_def_t), pointer :: def => null ()
     integer :: i_component = 0
     integer :: i_external = 0
     class(prc_core_driver_t), allocatable :: driver
   contains
   \LA{}Process libraries: process library entry: TBP\RA{}
  end type process_library_entry_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{628}Here are the available status codes.  An entry starts with
{\Tt{}UNKNOWN\nwendquote} status.  Once the association with a valid process
definition is established, the status becomes {\Tt{}CONFIGURED\nwendquote}.
If matrix element source code is to be generated by the system or
provided from elsewhere, {\Tt{}CODE{\_}GENERATED\nwendquote} indicates that this is
done.  The {\Tt{}COMPILED\nwendquote} status is next, it also applies to
processes which are accessed as precompiled binaries.  Finally, the
library is linked and process pointers are set; this is marked as
{\Tt{}LOADED\nwendquote}.

For a process library, the initial status is {\Tt{}OPEN\nwendquote}, since process
definitions may be added.  After configuration, the process content is fixed
and the status becomes {\Tt{}CONFIGURED\nwendquote}.  The further states are as above,
always referring to the lowest status among the process entries.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{629}\moddef{Process libraries: parameters}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  integer, parameter, public :: STAT_UNKNOWN = 0
  integer, parameter, public :: STAT_OPEN = 1
  integer, parameter, public :: STAT_CONFIGURED = 2
  integer, parameter, public :: STAT_SOURCE = 3
  integer, parameter, public :: STAT_COMPILED = 4
  integer, parameter, public :: STAT_LINKED = 5
  integer, parameter, public :: STAT_ACTIVE = 6

  integer, parameter, public :: ASSOCIATED_BORN = 1
  integer, parameter, public :: ASSOCIATED_REAL = 2
  integer, parameter, public :: ASSOCIATED_VIRT = 3
  integer, parameter, public :: ASSOCIATED_SUB = 4
  integer, parameter, public :: ASSOCIATED_PDF = 5
  integer, parameter, public :: ASSOCIATED_REAL_SING = 6
  integer, parameter, public :: ASSOCIATED_REAL_FIN = 7
  integer, parameter, public :: N_ASSOCIATED_COMPONENTS = 7

\eatline
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{630}These are the associated code letters, for output:
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{631}\moddef{Process libraries: parameters}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  character, dimension(0:6), parameter :: STATUS_LETTER = &
       ["?", "o", "f", "s", "c", "l", "a"]

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{632}This produces a condensed account of the library entry.  The status
is indicated by a letter in brackets, then the ID and component index
of the associated process definition, finally the library index, if available.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{633}\moddef{Process libraries: process library entry: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: to_string => process_library_entry_to_string
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{634}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_library_entry_to_string (object) result (string)
    type(string_t) :: string
    class(process_library_entry_t), intent(in) :: object
    character(32) :: buffer
    string = "[" // STATUS_LETTER(object%status) // "]"
    select case (object%status)
    case (STAT_UNKNOWN)
    case default
       if (associated (object%def)) then
          write (buffer, "(I0)")  object%i_component
          string = string // " " // object%def%id // "." // trim (buffer)
       end if
       if (object%i_external /= 0) then
          write (buffer, "(I0)")  object%i_external
          string = string // " = ext:" // trim (buffer)
       else
          string = string // " = int"
       end if
       if (allocated (object%driver)) then
          string = string // " (" // object%driver%type_name () // ")"
       end if
    end select
  end function process_library_entry_to_string

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{635}Initialize with data.  Used for the unit tests.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{636}\moddef{Process libraries: process library entry: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => process_library_entry_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{637}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_entry_init (object, &
       status, def, i_component, i_external, driver_template)
    class(process_library_entry_t), intent(out) :: object
    integer, intent(in) :: status
    type(process_def_t), target, intent(in) :: def
    integer, intent(in) :: i_component
    integer, intent(in) :: i_external
    class(prc_core_driver_t), intent(inout), allocatable, optional &
         :: driver_template
    object%status = status
    object%def => def
    object%i_component = i_component
    object%i_external = i_external
    if (present (driver_template)) then
       call move_alloc (driver_template, object%driver)
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_entry_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{638}Assign pointers for all process-specific features.  We have to
combine the method from the {\Tt{}core{\_}def\nwendquote} specification, the
assigned pointers within the library driver, the index within that
driver, and the process driver which should receive the links.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{639}\moddef{Process libraries: process library entry: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: connect => process_library_entry_connect
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{640}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_entry_connect (entry, lib_driver, i)
    class(process_library_entry_t), intent(inout) :: entry
    class(prclib_driver_t), intent(in) :: lib_driver
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    call entry%def%initial(entry%i_component)%connect &
         (lib_driver, i, entry%driver)
  end subroutine process_library_entry_connect

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{641}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{The process library object}
The {\Tt{}process{\_}library{\_}t\nwendquote} type is an extension of the
{\Tt{}process{\_}def{\_}list{\_}t\nwendquote} type.  Thus, it automatically contains the
process definition list.

The {\Tt{}basename\nwendquote} identifies the library generically.

The {\Tt{}external\nwendquote} flag is true if any process within the library needs external
code, so the library must correspond to an actual code library (statically or
dynamically linked).

The {\Tt{}entry\nwendquote} array contains all process components that can be handled by this
library. Each entry refers to the process (component) definition and to the
associated external matrix element code, if there is any.

The {\Tt{}driver\nwendquote} object is needed only if {\Tt{}external\nwendquote} is true.  This object
handles all interactions with external matrix-element code.

The {\Tt{}md5sum\nwendquote} summarizes the complete {\Tt{}process{\_}def{\_}list{\_}t\nwendquote} base
object.  It can be used to check if the library configuration has changed.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{642}\moddef{Process libraries: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: process_library_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{643}\moddef{Process libraries: types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (process_def_list_t) :: process_library_t
     private
     type(string_t) :: basename
     integer :: n_entries = 0
     logical :: external = .false.
     integer :: status = STAT_UNKNOWN
     logical :: static = .false.
     logical :: driver_exists = .false.
     logical :: makefile_exists = .false.
     integer :: update_counter = 0
     type(process_library_entry_t), dimension(:), allocatable :: entry
     class(prclib_driver_t), allocatable :: driver
     character(32) :: md5sum = ""
   contains
   \LA{}Process libraries: process library: TBP\RA{}
  end type process_library_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{644}For the output, we write first the metadata and the DL access
record, then the library entries in short form, and finally the
process definition list which is the base object.

Don't write the MD5 sum since this is used to generate it.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{645}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => process_library_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{646}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_write (object, unit, libpath)
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: libpath
    integer :: i, u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    write (u, "(1x,A,A)")  "Process library: ", char (object%basename)
    write (u, "(3x,A,L1)")   "external        = ", object%external
    write (u, "(3x,A,L1)")   "makefile exists = ", object%makefile_exists
    write (u, "(3x,A,L1)")   "driver exists   = ", object%driver_exists
    write (u, "(3x,A,A1)")   "code status     = ", &
         STATUS_LETTER (object%status)
    write (u, *)
    if (allocated (object%entry)) then
       write (u, "(1x,A)", advance="no")  "Process library entries:"
       write (u, "(1x,I0)")  object%n_entries
       do i = 1, size (object%entry)
          write (u, "(1x,A,I0,A,A)")  "Entry #", i, ": ", &
               char (object%entry(i)%to_string ())
       end do
       write (u, *)
    end if
    if (object%external) then
       call object%driver%write (u, libpath)
       write (u, *)
    end if
    call object%process_def_list_t%write (u)
  end subroutine process_library_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{647}Condensed version for screen output.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{648}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: show => process_library_show
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{649}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_show (object, unit)
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    write (u, "(A,A)")  "Process library: ", char (object%basename)
    write (u, "(2x,A,L1)")   "external        = ", object%external
    if (object%static) then
       write (u, "(2x,A,L1)")   "static          = ", .true.
    else
       write (u, "(2x,A,L1)")   "makefile exists = ", object%makefile_exists
       write (u, "(2x,A,L1)")   "driver exists   = ", object%driver_exists
    end if
    write (u, "(2x,A,A1)", advance="no")   "code status     = "
    select case (object%status)
    case (STAT_UNKNOWN);    write (u, "(A)")  "[unknown]"
    case (STAT_OPEN);       write (u, "(A)")  "open"
    case (STAT_CONFIGURED); write (u, "(A)")  "configured"
    case (STAT_SOURCE);     write (u, "(A)")  "source code exists"
    case (STAT_COMPILED);   write (u, "(A)")  "compiled"
    case (STAT_LINKED);     write (u, "(A)")  "linked"
    case (STAT_ACTIVE);     write (u, "(A)")  "active"
    end select
    call object%process_def_list_t%show (u)
  end subroutine process_library_show

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{650}\nwdocspar
The initializer defines just the basename.  We may now add process definitions
to the library.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{651}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => process_library_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{652}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_init (lib, basename)
    class(process_library_t), intent(out) :: lib
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: basename
    lib%basename = basename
    lib%status = STAT_OPEN
    call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (basename) &
         // "': initialized")
  end subroutine process_library_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{653}\nwdocspar
This alternative initializer declares the library as static.  We
should now add process definitions to the library, but all external
process code exists already.  We need the driver object, and we should
check the defined processes against the stored ones.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{654}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init_static => process_library_init_static
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{655}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_init_static (lib, basename)
    class(process_library_t), intent(out) :: lib
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: basename
    lib%basename = basename
    lib%status = STAT_OPEN
    lib%static = .true.
    call msg_message ("Static process library '" // char (basename) &
         // "': initialized")
  end subroutine process_library_init_static

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{656}The {\Tt{}configure\nwendquote} procedure scans the allocated entries in the process
definition list.  The configuration proceeds in three passes.

In the first pass, we scan the process definition list and count the
number of process components and the number of components which need
external code.  This is used to allocate the {\Tt{}entry\nwendquote} array.

In the second pass, we initialize the {\Tt{}entry\nwendquote} elements which connect
process definitions, process driver objects, and external code.

In the third pass, we initialize the library driver object, allocating
an entry for each external matrix element.

NOTE: Currently we handle only {\Tt{}initial\nwendquote} process components; {\Tt{}extra\nwendquote}
components are ignored.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{657}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: configure => process_library_configure
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{658}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_configure (lib, os_data)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    type(os_data_t), intent(in) :: os_data
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: def_entry
    integer :: n_entries, n_external, i_entry, i_external
    type(string_t) :: model_name
    integer :: i_component

    n_entries = 0
    n_external = 0
    if (allocated (lib%entry))  deallocate (lib%entry)

    def_entry => lib%first
    do while (associated (def_entry))
       do i_component = 1, def_entry%n_initial
          n_entries = n_entries + 1
          if (def_entry%initial(i_component)%needs_code ()) then
             n_external = n_external + 1
             lib%external = .true.
          end if
       end do
       def_entry => def_entry%next
    end do

    call lib%allocate_entries (n_entries)

    i_entry = 0
    i_external = 0
    def_entry => lib%first
    do while (associated (def_entry))
       do i_component = 1, def_entry%n_initial
          i_entry = i_entry + 1
          associate (lib_entry => lib%entry(i_entry))
            lib_entry%status = STAT_CONFIGURED
            lib_entry%def => def_entry%process_def_t
            lib_entry%i_component = i_component
            if (def_entry%initial(i_component)%needs_code ()) then
               i_external = i_external + 1
               lib_entry%i_external = i_external
            end if
            call def_entry%initial(i_component)%allocate_driver &
                 (lib_entry%driver)
          end associate
       end do
       def_entry => def_entry%next
    end do

    call dispatch_prclib_driver (lib%driver, &
         lib%basename, lib%get_modellibs_ldflags (os_data))
    call lib%driver%init (n_external)
    do i_entry = 1, n_entries
       associate (lib_entry => lib%entry(i_entry))
         i_component = lib_entry%i_component
         model_name = lib_entry%def%model_name
         associate (def => lib_entry%def%initial(i_component))
           if (def%needs_code ()) then
              call lib%driver%set_record (lib_entry%i_external, &
                   def%basename, &
                   model_name, &
                   def%get_features (), def%get_writer_ptr ())
           end if
         end associate
       end associate
    end do

    if (lib%static) then
       if (lib%n_entries /= 0)  lib%entry%status = STAT_LINKED
       lib%status = STAT_LINKED
    else if (lib%external) then
       where (lib%entry%i_external == 0)  lib%entry%status = STAT_LINKED
       lib%status = STAT_CONFIGURED
       lib%makefile_exists = .false.
       lib%driver_exists = .false.
    else
       if (lib%n_entries /= 0)  lib%entry%status = STAT_LINKED
       lib%status = STAT_LINKED
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_configure

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{659}Basic setup: allocate the {\Tt{}entry\nwendquote} array.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{660}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: allocate_entries => process_library_allocate_entries
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{661}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_allocate_entries (lib, n_entries)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    integer, intent(in) :: n_entries
    lib%n_entries = n_entries
    allocate (lib%entry (n_entries))
  end subroutine process_library_allocate_entries

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{662}Initialize an entry with data (used by unit tests).
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{663}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init_entry => process_library_init_entry
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{664}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_init_entry (lib, i, &
       status, def, i_component, i_external, driver_template)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: status
    type(process_def_t), target, intent(in) :: def
    integer, intent(in) :: i_component
    integer, intent(in) :: i_external
    class(prc_core_driver_t), intent(inout), allocatable, optional &
         :: driver_template
    call lib%entry(i)%init (status, def, i_component, i_external, &
         driver_template)
  end subroutine process_library_init_entry

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{665}Compute the MD5 sum.  We concatenate the individual MD5 sums of all
processes (which, in turn, are derived from the MD5 sums of their
components) and compute the MD5 sum of that.

This should be executed \emph{after} configuration, where the driver was
initialized, since otherwise the MD5 sum stored in the driver would be
overwritten.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{666}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: compute_md5sum => process_library_compute_md5sum
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{667}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_compute_md5sum (lib, model)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    class(model_data_t), intent(in), optional, target :: model
    type(process_def_entry_t), pointer :: def_entry
    type(string_t) :: buffer
    buffer = lib%basename
    def_entry => lib%first
    do while (associated (def_entry))
       call def_entry%compute_md5sum (model)
       buffer = buffer // def_entry%md5sum
       def_entry => def_entry%next
    end do
    lib%md5sum = md5sum (char (buffer))
    call lib%driver%set_md5sum (lib%md5sum)
  end subroutine process_library_compute_md5sum

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{668}Write an appropriate makefile, if there are external processes.  Unless
{\Tt{}force\nwendquote} is in effect, first check if there is already a makefile with the
correct MD5 sum.  If yes, do nothing.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{669}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write_makefile => process_library_write_makefile
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{670}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_write_makefile (lib, os_data, force, testflag)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    type(os_data_t), intent(in) :: os_data
    logical, intent(in) :: force
    logical, intent(in), optional :: testflag
    character(32) :: md5sum_file
    logical :: generate
    integer :: unit
    if (lib%external .and. .not. lib%static) then
       generate = .true.
       if (.not. force) then
          md5sum_file = lib%driver%get_md5sum_makefile ()
          if (lib%md5sum == md5sum_file) then
             call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
                  // "': keeping makefile")
             generate = .false.
          end if
       end if
       if (generate) then
          call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
               // "': writing makefile")
          unit = free_unit ()
          open (unit, file = char (lib%driver%basename // ".makefile"), &
               status="replace", action="write")
          call lib%driver%generate_makefile (unit, os_data, testflag)
          close (unit)
       end if
       lib%makefile_exists = .true.
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_write_makefile

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{671}Write the driver source code for the library to file, if there are
external processes.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{672}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write_driver => process_library_write_driver
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{673}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_write_driver (lib, force)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    logical, intent(in) :: force
    character(32) :: md5sum_file
    logical :: generate
    integer :: unit
    if (lib%external .and. .not. lib%static) then
       generate = .true.
       if (.not. force) then
          md5sum_file = lib%driver%get_md5sum_driver ()
          if (lib%md5sum == md5sum_file) then
             call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
                  // "': keeping driver")
             generate = .false.
          end if
       end if
       if (generate) then
          call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
               // "': writing driver")
          unit = free_unit ()
          open (unit, file = char (lib%driver%basename // ".f90"), &
               status="replace", action="write")
          call lib%driver%generate_driver_code (unit)
          close (unit)
       end if
       lib%driver_exists = .true.
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_write_driver

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{674}Update the compilation status of an external library.

Strictly speaking, this is not necessary for a one-time run, since the
individual library methods will update the status themselves.
However, it allows us to identify compilation steps that we can skip
because the file exists or is already loaded, for the whole library or
for particular entries.

Independently, the building process is controlled by a makefile.
Thus, previous files are reused if they are not modified by the
current compilation.
\begin{enumerate}
\item
  If it is not already loaded, attempt to load the library.  If successful,
  check the overall MD5 sum.  If it matches, just keep it loaded and mark as
  ACTIVE.  If not, check the MD5 sum for all linked process components.
  Where it matches, mark the entry as COMPILED.  Then, unload the library and
  mark as CONFIGURED.

  Thus, we can identify compiled files for all matrix elements which are
  accessible via the previous compiled library, even if it is no longer up to
  date.
\item
  If the library is now in CONFIGURED state, look for valid source files.
  Each entry that is just in CONFIGURED state will advance to SOURCE if the
  MD5 sum matches.  Finally, advance the whole library to SOURCE if all
  entries are at least in this condition.
\end{enumerate}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{675}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: update_status => process_library_update_status
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{676}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_update_status (lib, os_data)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    type(os_data_t), intent(in) :: os_data
    character(32) :: md5sum_file
    integer :: i, i_external, i_component
    if (lib%external) then
       select case (lib%status)
       case (STAT_CONFIGURED:STAT_LINKED)
          call lib%driver%load (os_data, noerror=.true.)
       end select
       if (lib%driver%loaded) then
          md5sum_file = lib%driver%get_md5sum (0)
          if (lib%md5sum == md5sum_file) then
             call lib%load_entries ()
             lib%entry%status = STAT_ACTIVE
             lib%status = STAT_ACTIVE
             call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
                  // "': active")
          else
             do i = 1, lib%n_entries
                associate (entry => lib%entry(i))
                  i_external = entry%i_external
                  i_component = entry%i_component
                  if (i_external /= 0) then
                     md5sum_file = lib%driver%get_md5sum (i_external)
                     if (entry%def%get_md5sum (i_component) == md5sum_file) then
                        entry%status = STAT_COMPILED
                     else
                        entry%status = STAT_CONFIGURED
                     end if
                  end if
                end associate
             end do
             call lib%driver%unload ()
             lib%status = STAT_CONFIGURED
          end if
       end if
       select case (lib%status)
       case (STAT_CONFIGURED)
          do i = 1, lib%n_entries
             associate (entry => lib%entry(i))
               i_external = entry%i_external
               i_component = entry%i_component
               if (i_external /= 0) then
                  select case (entry%status)
                  case (STAT_CONFIGURED)
                     md5sum_file = lib%driver%get_md5sum_source (i_external)
                     if (entry%def%get_md5sum (i_component) == md5sum_file) then
                        entry%status = STAT_SOURCE
                     end if
                  end select
               end if
             end associate
          end do
          if (all (lib%entry%status >= STAT_SOURCE)) then
             md5sum_file = lib%driver%get_md5sum_driver ()
             if (lib%md5sum == md5sum_file) then
                lib%status = STAT_SOURCE
             end if
          end if
       end select
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_update_status

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{677}\nwdocspar
This procedure triggers code generation for all processes where this
is possible.

We generate code only for external processes of status
{\Tt{}STAT{\_}CONFIGURED\nwendquote}, which then advance to {\Tt{}STAT{\_}SOURCE\nwendquote}.  If, for a
particular process, the status is already advanced, we do not remove previous
files, so {\Tt{}make\nwendquote} will consider them as up to date if they exist.  Otherwise,
we remove those files to force a fresh {\Tt{}make\nwendquote}.

Finally, if any source code has been generated, we need a driver file.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{678}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: make_source => process_library_make_source
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{679}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_make_source (lib, os_data, keep_old_source)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    type(os_data_t), intent(in) :: os_data
    logical, intent(in), optional :: keep_old_source
    logical :: keep_old
    integer :: i, i_external
    keep_old = .false.
    if (present (keep_old_source))  keep_old = keep_old_source
    if (lib%external .and. .not. lib%static) then
       select case (lib%status)
       case (STAT_CONFIGURED)
          if (keep_old) then
             call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
                  // "': keeping source code")
          else
             call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
                  // "': creating source code")
             do i = 1, size (lib%entry)
                associate (entry => lib%entry(i))
                  i_external = entry%i_external
                  if (i_external /= 0 &
                       .and. lib%entry(i)%status == STAT_CONFIGURED) then
                     call lib%driver%clean_proc (i_external, os_data)
                  end if
                end associate
                if (signal_is_pending ())  return
             end do
             call lib%driver%make_source (os_data)
          end if
          lib%status = STAT_SOURCE
          where (lib%entry%i_external /= 0 &
               .and. lib%entry%status == STAT_CONFIGURED)
             lib%entry%status = STAT_SOURCE
          end where
          lib%status = STAT_SOURCE
       end select
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_make_source

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{680}Compile the generated code and update the status codes.  Try to make
the sources first, just in case. This includes compiling possible \LaTeX
Feynman diagram files.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{681}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: make_compile => process_library_make_compile
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{682}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_make_compile (lib, os_data, keep_old_source)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    type(os_data_t), intent(in) :: os_data
    logical, intent(in), optional :: keep_old_source
    if (lib%external .and. .not. lib%static) then
       select case (lib%status)
       case (STAT_CONFIGURED)
          call lib%make_source (os_data, keep_old_source)
       end select
       if (signal_is_pending ())  return
       select case (lib%status)
       case (STAT_SOURCE)
          call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
               // "': compiling sources")
          call lib%driver%make_compile (os_data)
          where (lib%entry%i_external /= 0 &
               .and. lib%entry%status == STAT_SOURCE)
             lib%entry%status = STAT_COMPILED
          end where
          lib%status = STAT_COMPILED
       end select
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_make_compile

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{683}Link the process library.  Try to compile first, just in case.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{684}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: make_link => process_library_make_link
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{685}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_make_link (lib, os_data, keep_old_source)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    type(os_data_t), intent(in) :: os_data
    logical, intent(in), optional :: keep_old_source
    if (lib%external .and. .not. lib%static) then
       select case (lib%status)
       case (STAT_CONFIGURED:STAT_SOURCE)
          call lib%make_compile (os_data, keep_old_source)
       end select
       if (signal_is_pending ())  return
       select case (lib%status)
       case (STAT_COMPILED)
          call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
               // "': linking")
          call lib%driver%make_link (os_data)
          lib%entry%status = STAT_LINKED
          lib%status = STAT_LINKED
       end select
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_make_link

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{686}Load the process library, i.e., assign pointers to the library
functions.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{687}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: load => process_library_load
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{688}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_load (lib, os_data, keep_old_source)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    type(os_data_t), intent(in) :: os_data
    logical, intent(in), optional :: keep_old_source
    select case (lib%status)
    case (STAT_CONFIGURED:STAT_COMPILED)
       call lib%make_link (os_data, keep_old_source)
    end select
    if (signal_is_pending ())  return
    select case (lib%status)
    case (STAT_LINKED)
       if (lib%external) then
          call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
               // "': loading")
          call lib%driver%load (os_data)
          call lib%load_entries ()
       end if
       lib%entry%status = STAT_ACTIVE
       lib%status = STAT_ACTIVE
    end select
  end subroutine process_library_load

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{689}This is the actual loading part for the process methods.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{690}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: load_entries => process_library_load_entries
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{691}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_load_entries (lib)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size (lib%entry)
       associate (entry => lib%entry(i))
         if (entry%i_external /= 0) then
            call entry%connect (lib%driver, entry%i_external)
         end if
       end associate
    end do
  end subroutine process_library_load_entries

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{692}Unload the library, if possible.  This reverts the status to ``linked''.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{693}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: unload => process_library_unload
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{694}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_unload (lib)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    select case (lib%status)
    case (STAT_ACTIVE)
       if (lib%external) then
          call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
               // "': unloading")
          call lib%driver%unload ()
       end if
       lib%entry%status = STAT_LINKED
       lib%status = STAT_LINKED
    end select
  end subroutine process_library_unload

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{695}Unload, clean all generated files and revert the library status.  If
{\Tt{}distclean\nwendquote} is set, also remove the makefile and the driver source.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{696}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: clean => process_library_clean
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{697}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_clean (lib, os_data, distclean)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    type(os_data_t), intent(in) :: os_data
    logical, intent(in) :: distclean
    call lib%unload ()
    if (lib%external .and. .not. lib%static) then
       call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
            // "': removing old files")
       if (distclean) then
          call lib%driver%distclean (os_data)
       else
          call lib%driver%clean (os_data)
       end if
    end if
    where (lib%entry%i_external /= 0)
       lib%entry%status = STAT_CONFIGURED
    elsewhere
       lib%entry%status = STAT_LINKED
    end where
    if (lib%external) then
       lib%status = STAT_CONFIGURED
    else
       lib%status = STAT_LINKED
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_clean

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{698}Unload and clean the compiled library and all generated object files, so
force a recompilation.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{699}\moddef{XXX Process libraries: process library: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: clean_objects => process_library_clean_objects
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{700}\moddef{XXX Process libraries: procedures}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_clean_objects (lib, os_data)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    type(os_data_t), intent(in) :: os_data
    call lib%unload ()
    if (lib%external .and. .not. lib%static) then
       call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
            // "': removing compiled objects")
       call lib%driver%clean_library (os_data)
       call lib%driver%clean_objects (os_data)
    end if
    where (lib%entry%i_external /= 0)
       lib%entry%status = STAT_CONFIGURED
    elsewhere
       lib%entry%status = STAT_LINKED
    end where
    if (lib%external) then
       lib%status = STAT_CONFIGURED
    else
       lib%status = STAT_LINKED
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_clean_objects

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{701}Unload and revert the library status to INITIAL.  This allows for
appending new processes.  No files are deleted.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{702}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: open => process_library_open
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{703}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_open (lib)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    select case (lib%status)
    case (STAT_OPEN)
    case default
       call lib%unload ()
       if (.not. lib%static) then
          lib%entry%status = STAT_OPEN
          lib%status = STAT_OPEN
          if (lib%external)  lib%update_counter = lib%update_counter + 1
          call msg_message ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
               // "': open")
       else
          call msg_error ("Static process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
               // "': processes can't be appended")
       end if
    end select
  end subroutine process_library_open

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{704}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Use the library}
Return the base name of the library
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{705}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_name => process_library_get_name
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{706}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_library_get_name (lib) result (name)
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: lib
    type(string_t) :: name
    name = lib%basename
  end function process_library_get_name

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{707}\nwdocspar
Once activated, we view the process library object as an interface for
accessing the matrix elements.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{708}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: is_active => process_library_is_active
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{709}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_library_is_active (lib) result (flag)
    logical :: flag
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: lib
    flag = lib%status == STAT_ACTIVE
  end function process_library_is_active

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{710}Return the current status code of the library.  If an index is
provided, return the status of that entry.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{711}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_status => process_library_get_status
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{712}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_library_get_status (lib, i) result (status)
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: lib
    integer, intent(in), optional :: i
    integer :: status
    if (present (i)) then
       status = lib%entry(i)%status
    else
       status = lib%status
    end if
  end function process_library_get_status

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{713}Return the update counter.  Since this is incremented each time the
library is re-opened, we can use this to check if existing pointers to
matrix element code are still valid.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{714}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_update_counter => process_library_get_update_counter
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{715}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_library_get_update_counter (lib) result (counter)
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: lib
    integer :: counter
    counter = lib%update_counter
  end function process_library_get_update_counter

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{716}Manually set the current status code of the library.  If the
optional flag is set, set also the entry status codes.  This is used
for unit tests.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{717}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: set_status => process_library_set_status
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{718}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_set_status (lib, status, entries)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    integer, intent(in) :: status
    logical, intent(in), optional :: entries
    lib%status = status
    if (present (entries)) then
       if (entries)  lib%entry%status = status
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_set_status

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{719}Return the load status of the associated driver.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{720}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: is_loaded => process_library_is_loaded
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{721}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_library_is_loaded (lib) result (flag)
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: lib
    logical :: flag
    flag = lib%driver%loaded
  end function process_library_is_loaded

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{722}Retrieve constants using the process library driver.  We assume that
the process code has been loaded, if external.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{723}\moddef{Process libraries: process library entry: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: fill_constants => process_library_entry_fill_constants
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{724}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_entry_fill_constants (entry, driver, data)
    class(process_library_entry_t), intent(in) :: entry
    class(prclib_driver_t), intent(in) :: driver
    type(process_constants_t), intent(out) :: data
    integer :: i
    if (entry%i_external /= 0) then
       i = entry%i_external
       data%id         = driver%get_process_id (i)
       data%model_name = driver%get_model_name (i)
       data%md5sum     = driver%get_md5sum (i)
       data%openmp_supported = driver%get_openmp_status (i)
       data%n_in  = driver%get_n_in  (i)
       data%n_out = driver%get_n_out (i)
       data%n_flv = driver%get_n_flv (i)
       data%n_hel = driver%get_n_hel (i)
       data%n_col = driver%get_n_col (i)
       data%n_cin = driver%get_n_cin (i)
       data%n_cf  = driver%get_n_cf  (i)
       call driver%set_flv_state (i, data%flv_state)
       call driver%set_hel_state (i, data%hel_state)
       call driver%set_col_state (i, data%col_state, data%ghost_flag)
       call driver%set_color_factors (i, data%color_factors, data%cf_index)
    else
       select type (proc_driver => entry%driver)
       class is (process_driver_internal_t)
          call proc_driver%fill_constants (data)
       end select
    end if
  end subroutine process_library_entry_fill_constants

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{725}Retrieve the constants for a process
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{726}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: fill_constants => process_library_fill_constants
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{727}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_fill_constants (lib, id, i_component, data)
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: lib
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    integer, intent(in) :: i_component
    type(process_constants_t), intent(out) :: data
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size (lib%entry)
       associate (entry => lib%entry(i))
          if (entry%def%id == id .and. entry%i_component == i_component) then
             call entry%fill_constants (lib%driver, data)
             return
          end if
       end associate
    end do
  end subroutine process_library_fill_constants

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{728}Retrieve the constants and a connected driver for a process,
identified by a process ID and a subprocess index.  We
scan the process entries until we have found a match.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{729}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: connect_process => process_library_connect_process
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{730}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_connect_process &
       (lib, id, i_component, data, proc_driver)
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: lib
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    integer, intent(in) :: i_component
    type(process_constants_t), intent(out) :: data
    class(prc_core_driver_t), allocatable, intent(out) :: proc_driver
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size (lib%entry)
       associate (entry => lib%entry(i))
         if (entry%def%id == id .and. entry%i_component == i_component) then
            call entry%fill_constants (lib%driver, data)
            allocate (proc_driver, source = entry%driver)
            return
         end if
       end associate
    end do
    call msg_fatal ("Process library '" // char (lib%basename) &
               // "': process '" // char (id) // "' not found")
  end subroutine process_library_connect_process

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{731}\nwdocspar
Shortcut for use in unit tests: fetch the MD5sum from a specific
library entry and inject it into the writer of a specific record.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{732}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: test_transfer_md5sum => process_library_test_transfer_md5sum
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{733}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine process_library_test_transfer_md5sum (lib, r, e, c)
    class(process_library_t), intent(inout) :: lib
    integer, intent(in) :: r, e, c
    associate (writer => lib%driver%record(r)%writer)
       writer%md5sum = lib%entry(e)%def%get_md5sum (c)
    end associate
  end subroutine process_library_test_transfer_md5sum

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{734}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{735}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_nlo_type => process_library_get_nlo_type
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{736}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_library_get_nlo_type (lib, id, i_component) result (nlo_type)
    integer :: nlo_type
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: lib
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: id
    integer, intent(in) :: i_component
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size (lib%entry)
       if (lib%entry(i)%def%id == id .and. lib%entry(i)%i_component == i_component) then
          nlo_type = lib%entry(i)%def%get_nlo_type (i_component)
          exit
       end if
    end do
  end function process_library_get_nlo_type

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{737}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Collect model-specific libraries}
This returns appropriate linker flags for the model parameter libraries that
are used by the generated matrix element.  At the end, the main libwhizard is
appended (again), because functions from that may be reqired.

Extra models in the local user space need to be treated individually.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{738}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_modellibs_ldflags => process_library_get_modellibs_ldflags
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{739}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_library_get_modellibs_ldflags (prc_lib, os_data) result (flags)
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: prc_lib
    type(os_data_t), intent(in) :: os_data
    type(string_t) :: flags
    type(string_t), dimension(:), allocatable :: models
    type(string_t) :: modelname, modellib, modellib_full
    logical :: exist
    integer :: i, j, mi
    flags = " -lomega"
    if ((.not. os_data%use_testfiles) .and. &
               os_dir_exist (os_data%whizard_models_libpath_local)) &
                 flags = flags // " -L" // os_data%whizard_models_libpath_local
    flags = flags // " -L" // os_data%whizard_models_libpath
    allocate (models(prc_lib%n_entries + 1))
    models = ""
    mi = 1
    if (allocated (prc_lib%entry)) then
       SCAN: do i = 1, prc_lib%n_entries
          if (associated (prc_lib%entry(i)%def)) then
             if (prc_lib%entry(i)%def%model_name /= "") then
                modelname = prc_lib%entry(i)%def%model_name
             else
                cycle SCAN
             end if
          else
             cycle SCAN
          end if
          do j = 1, mi
             if (models(mi) == modelname) cycle SCAN
          end do
          models(mi) = modelname
          mi = mi + 1
          if (os_data%use_libtool) then
             modellib = "libparameters_" // modelname // ".la"
          else
             modellib = "libparameters_" // modelname // ".a"
          end if
          exist = .false.
          if (.not. os_data%use_testfiles) then
             modellib_full = os_data%whizard_models_libpath_local &
                  // "/" // modellib
             inquire (file=char (modellib_full), exist=exist)
          end if
          if (.not. exist) then
             modellib_full = os_data%whizard_models_libpath &
                  // "/" // modellib
             inquire (file=char (modellib_full), exist=exist)
          end if
          if (exist) flags = flags // " -lparameters_" // modelname
       end do SCAN
    end if
    deallocate (models)
    flags = flags // " -lwhizard"
  end function process_library_get_modellibs_ldflags

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{740}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{741}\moddef{Process libraries: process library: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_static_modelname => process_library_get_static_modelname
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{742}\moddef{Process libraries: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function process_library_get_static_modelname (prc_lib, os_data) result (name)
    class(process_library_t), intent(in) :: prc_lib
    type(os_data_t), intent(in) :: os_data
    type(string_t) :: name
    type(string_t), dimension(:), allocatable :: models
    type(string_t) :: modelname, modellib, modellib_full
    logical :: exist
    integer :: i, j, mi
    name = ""
    allocate (models(prc_lib%n_entries + 1))
    models = ""
    mi = 1
    if (allocated (prc_lib%entry)) then
       SCAN: do i = 1, prc_lib%n_entries
          if (associated (prc_lib%entry(i)%def)) then
             if (prc_lib%entry(i)%def%model_name /= "") then
                modelname = prc_lib%entry(i)%def%model_name
             else
                cycle SCAN
             end if
          else
             cycle SCAN
          end if
          do j = 1, mi
             if (models(mi) == modelname) cycle SCAN
          end do
          models(mi) = modelname
          mi = mi + 1
          modellib = "libparameters_" // modelname // ".a"
          exist = .false.
          if (.not. os_data%use_testfiles) then
             modellib_full = os_data%whizard_models_libpath_local &
                  // "/" // modellib
             inquire (file=char (modellib_full), exist=exist)
          end if
          if (.not. exist) then
             modellib_full = os_data%whizard_models_libpath &
                  // "/" // modellib
             inquire (file=char (modellib_full), exist=exist)
          end if
          if (exist) name = name // " " // modellib_full
       end do SCAN
    end if
    deallocate (models)
  end function process_library_get_static_modelname

\eatline
