                  if (sf%int%status <= SF_FAILED_KINEMATICS) then
                     chain%status = SF_FAILED_KINEMATICS
                     return
                  end if
                  do c = 1, size (sf%f)
                     if (c /= c_sel) then
                        call sf%int%inverse_kinematics &
                             (sf%x, sf%f(c), sf%r(:,c), sf%rb(:,c), sf%m(c))
                        do j = 1, size (sf%x)
                           chain%r (sf%int%par_index(j),c) = sf%r (j,c)
                           chain%rb(sf%int%par_index(j),c) = sf%rb(j,c)
                        end do
                     end if
                     chain%f(c) = chain%f(c) * sf%f(c)
                  end do
                  if (.not. sf%eval%is_empty ()) then
                     call sf%eval%receive_momenta ()
                  end if
                end associate
             end do
             do c = 1, size (chain%f)
                if (c /= c_sel) then
                   if (allocated (chain%channel(c)%multi_mapping)) then
                      call chain%channel(c)%multi_mapping%inverse &
                           (chain%r(:,c), chain%rb(:,c), &
                            f_mapping, &
                            chain%p(:,c), chain%pb(:,c), &
                            chain%x_free)
                      chain%f(c) = chain%f(c) * f_mapping
                   else
                      chain%p (:,c) = chain%r (:,c)
                      chain%pb(:,c) = chain%rb(:,c)
                   end if
                end if
             end do
          end if
       end if
       chain%status = SF_DONE_KINEMATICS
    end if
  end subroutine sf_chain_instance_compute_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{898}This is a variant of the previous procedure.  We know the $x$ parameters and
reconstruct the momenta and the MC input parameters {\Tt{}p\nwendquote}.  We do not need to
select a channel.

Note: this is probably redundant, since the method we actually want
starts from the momenta, recovers all $x$ parameters, and then
inverts mappings.  See below {\Tt{}recover{\_}kinematics\nwendquote}.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{899}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: inverse_kinematics => sf_chain_instance_inverse_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{900}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_chain_instance_inverse_kinematics (chain, x)
    class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(inout), target :: chain
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: x
    type(interaction_t), pointer :: int
    real(default) :: f_mapping
    integer :: i, j, c
    if (chain%status >= SF_DONE_CONNECTIONS) then
       call chain%select_channel ()
       int => beam_get_int_ptr (chain%beam_t)
       call int%receive_momenta ()
       if (allocated (chain%sf)) then
          chain%f = 1
          if (size (chain%sf) /= 0) then
             forall (i = 1:size (chain%sf))  chain%sf(i)%int%status = SF_INITIAL
             chain%x = x
             do i = 1, size (chain%sf)
                associate (sf => chain%sf(i))
                  call sf%int%seed_kinematics ()
                  do j = 1, size (sf%x)
                     sf%x(j) = chain%x(sf%int%par_index(j))
                  end do
                  do c = 1, size (sf%f)
                     call sf%int%inverse_kinematics &
                          (sf%x, sf%f(c), sf%r(:,c), sf%rb(:,c), sf%m(c), c==1)
                     chain%f(c) = chain%f(c) * sf%f(c)
                     do j = 1, size (sf%x)
                        chain%r (sf%int%par_index(j),c) = sf%r (j,c)
                        chain%rb(sf%int%par_index(j),c) = sf%rb(j,c)
                     end do
                  end do
                  if (.not. sf%eval%is_empty ()) then
                     call sf%eval%receive_momenta ()
                  end if
                end associate
             end do
             do c = 1, size (chain%f)
                if (allocated (chain%channel(c)%multi_mapping)) then
                   call chain%channel(c)%multi_mapping%inverse &
                        (chain%r(:,c), chain%rb(:,c), &
                        f_mapping, &
                        chain%p(:,c), chain%pb(:,c), &
                        chain%x_free)
                   chain%f(c) = chain%f(c) * f_mapping
                else
                   chain%p (:,c) = chain%r (:,c)
                   chain%pb(:,c) = chain%rb(:,c)
                end if
             end do
          end if
       end if
       chain%status = SF_DONE_KINEMATICS
    end if
  end subroutine sf_chain_instance_inverse_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{901}Recover the kinematics: assuming that the last evaluator has
been filled with a valid set of momenta, we travel the momentum links
backwards and fill the preceding evaluators and, as a side effect,
interactions.  We stop at the beam interaction.

After all momenta are set, apply the {\Tt{}inverse{\_}kinematics\nwendquote} procedure
above, suitably modified, to recover the $x$ and $p$ parameters and
the Jacobian factors.

The {\Tt{}c{\_}sel\nwendquote} (channel) argument is just used to mark a selected
channel for the records, otherwise the recovery procedure is
independent of this.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{902}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: recover_kinematics => sf_chain_instance_recover_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{903}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_chain_instance_recover_kinematics (chain, c_sel)
    class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(inout), target :: chain
    integer, intent(in) :: c_sel
    real(default) :: f_mapping
    integer :: i, j, c
    if (chain%status >= SF_DONE_CONNECTIONS) then
       call chain%select_channel (c_sel)
       if (allocated (chain%sf)) then
          do i = size (chain%sf), 1, -1
             associate (sf => chain%sf(i))
               if (.not. sf%eval%is_empty ()) then
                  call interaction_send_momenta (sf%eval%interaction_t)
               end if
             end associate
          end do
          chain%f = 1
          if (size (chain%sf) /= 0) then
             forall (i = 1:size (chain%sf))  chain%sf(i)%int%status = SF_INITIAL
             chain%x_free = 1
             do i = 1, size (chain%sf)
                associate (sf => chain%sf(i))
                  call sf%int%seed_kinematics ()
                  call sf%int%recover_x (sf%x, chain%x_free)
                  do j = 1, size (sf%x)
                     chain%x(sf%int%par_index(j)) = sf%x(j)
                  end do
                  do c = 1, size (sf%f)
                     call sf%int%inverse_kinematics &
                          (sf%x, sf%f(c), sf%r(:,c), sf%rb(:,c), sf%m(c), c==1)
                     chain%f(c) = chain%f(c) * sf%f(c)
                     do j = 1, size (sf%x)
                        chain%r (sf%int%par_index(j),c) = sf%r (j,c)
                        chain%rb(sf%int%par_index(j),c) = sf%rb(j,c)
                     end do
                  end do
                end associate
             end do
             do c = 1, size (chain%f)
                if (allocated (chain%channel(c)%multi_mapping)) then
                   call chain%channel(c)%multi_mapping%inverse &
                        (chain%r(:,c), chain%rb(:,c), &
                        f_mapping, &
                        chain%p(:,c), chain%pb(:,c), &
                        chain%x_free)
                   chain%f(c) = chain%f(c) * f_mapping
                else
                   chain%p (:,c) = chain%r (:,c)
                   chain%pb(:,c) = chain%rb(:,c)
                end if
             end do
          end if
       end if
       chain%status = SF_DONE_KINEMATICS
    end if
  end subroutine sf_chain_instance_recover_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{904}Return the initial beam momenta to their source, thus completing
kinematics recovery.  Obviously, this works as a side effect.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{905}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: return_beam_momenta => sf_chain_instance_return_beam_momenta
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{906}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_chain_instance_return_beam_momenta (chain)
    class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(in), target :: chain
    type(interaction_t), pointer :: int
    if (chain%status >= SF_DONE_KINEMATICS) then
       int => beam_get_int_ptr (chain%beam_t)
       call interaction_send_momenta (int)
    end if
  end subroutine sf_chain_instance_return_beam_momenta

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{907}Evaluate all interactions in the chain and the product evaluators.
We provide a {\Tt{}scale\nwendquote} argument that is given to all structure
functions in the chain.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{908}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: evaluate => sf_chain_instance_evaluate
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{909}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_chain_instance_evaluate (chain, scale)
    class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(inout), target :: chain
    real(default), intent(in) :: scale
    type(interaction_t), pointer :: out_int
    real(default) :: sf_sum
    integer :: i
    if (chain%status >= SF_DONE_KINEMATICS) then
       if (allocated (chain%sf)) then
          if (size (chain%sf) /= 0) then
             do i = 1, size (chain%sf)
                associate (sf => chain%sf(i))
                  call sf%int%apply (scale)
                  if (sf%int%status <= SF_FAILED_EVALUATION) then
                     chain%status = SF_FAILED_EVALUATION
                     return
                  end if
                  if (.not. sf%eval%is_empty ()) then
                     call sf%eval%evaluate ()
                  end if
                end associate
             end do
             out_int => chain%get_out_int_ptr ()
             sf_sum = real (out_int%sum ())
             call chain%config%trace &
                  (chain%selected_channel, chain%p, chain%x, chain%f, sf_sum)
          end if
       end if
       chain%status = SF_EVALUATED
    end if
  end subroutine sf_chain_instance_evaluate

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{910}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Access to the chain instance}
Transfer the outgoing momenta to the array {\Tt{}p\nwendquote}.  We assume that
array sizes match.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{911}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_out_momenta => sf_chain_instance_get_out_momenta
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{912}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_chain_instance_get_out_momenta (chain, p)
    class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(in), target :: chain
    type(vector4_t), dimension(:), intent(out) :: p
    type(interaction_t), pointer :: int
    integer :: i, j
    if (chain%status >= SF_DONE_KINEMATICS) then
       do j = 1, size (chain%out_sf)
          i = chain%out_sf(j)
          select case (i)
          case (0)
             int => beam_get_int_ptr (chain%beam_t)
          case default
             int => chain%sf(i)%int%interaction_t
          end select
          p(j) = int%get_momentum (chain%out_sf_i(j))
       end do
    end if
  end subroutine sf_chain_instance_get_out_momenta

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{913}Return a pointer to the last evaluator in the chain (to the interaction).
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{914}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_out_int_ptr => sf_chain_instance_get_out_int_ptr
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{915}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_chain_instance_get_out_int_ptr (chain) result (int)
    class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(in), target :: chain
    type(interaction_t), pointer :: int
    if (chain%out_eval == 0) then
       int => beam_get_int_ptr (chain%beam_t)
    else
       int => chain%sf(chain%out_eval)%eval%interaction_t
    end if
  end function sf_chain_instance_get_out_int_ptr

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{916}Return the index of the {\Tt{}j\nwendquote}-th outgoing particle, within the last
evaluator.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{917}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_out_i => sf_chain_instance_get_out_i
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{918}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_chain_instance_get_out_i (chain, j) result (i)
    class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(in) :: chain
    integer, intent(in) :: j
    integer :: i
    i = chain%out_eval_i(j)
  end function sf_chain_instance_get_out_i

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{919}Return the mask for the outgoing particle(s), within the last evaluator.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{920}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_out_mask => sf_chain_instance_get_out_mask
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{921}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_chain_instance_get_out_mask (chain) result (mask)
    class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(in), target :: chain
    type(quantum_numbers_mask_t), dimension(:), allocatable :: mask
    type(interaction_t), pointer :: int
    allocate (mask (chain%config%n_in))
    int => chain%get_out_int_ptr ()
    mask = int%get_mask (chain%out_eval_i)
  end function sf_chain_instance_get_out_mask

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{922}Return the array of MC input parameters that corresponds to channel {\Tt{}c\nwendquote}.
This is the {\Tt{}p\nwendquote} array, the parameters before all mappings.

The {\Tt{}p\nwendquote} array may be deallocated.  This should correspond to a
zero-size {\Tt{}r\nwendquote} argument, so nothing to do then.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{923}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_mcpar => sf_chain_instance_get_mcpar
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{924}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_chain_instance_get_mcpar (chain, c, r)
    class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(in) :: chain
    integer, intent(in) :: c
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: r
    if (allocated (chain%p))  r = pack (chain%p(:,c), chain%bound)
  end subroutine sf_chain_instance_get_mcpar

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{925}Return the Jacobian factor that corresponds to channel {\Tt{}c\nwendquote}.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{926}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_f => sf_chain_instance_get_f
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{927}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_chain_instance_get_f (chain, c) result (f)
    class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(in) :: chain
    integer, intent(in) :: c
    real(default) :: f
    if (allocated (chain%f)) then
       f = chain%f(c)
    else
       f = 1
    end if
  end function sf_chain_instance_get_f

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{928}Return the evaluation status.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{929}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_status => sf_chain_instance_get_status
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{930}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_chain_instance_get_status (chain) result (status)
    class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(in) :: chain
    integer :: status
    status = chain%status
  end function sf_chain_instance_get_status

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{931}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{932}\moddef{SF base: sf chain instance: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_matrix_elements => sf_chain_instance_get_matrix_elements
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{933}\moddef{SF base: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_chain_instance_get_matrix_elements (chain, i, ff)
     class(sf_chain_instance_t), intent(in) :: chain
     integer, intent(in) :: i
     real(default), intent(out), dimension(:), allocatable :: ff

     associate (sf => chain%sf(i))
        ff = real (sf%int%get_matrix_element ())
     end associate
  end subroutine sf_chain_instance_get_matrix_elements

\eatline

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{941}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Test implementation: structure function}
This is a template for the actual structure-function implementation
which will be defined in separate modules.

\subsubsection{Configuration data}
The test structure function uses the {\Tt{}Test\nwendquote} model.  It describes a
scalar within an arbitrary initial particle, which is given in the
initialization.  The radiated particle is also a scalar, the same one,
but we set its mass artificially to zero.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{942}\moddef{SF base: public test auxiliary}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_test_data_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{943}\moddef{SF base: test types}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (sf_data_t) :: sf_test_data_t
     class(model_data_t), pointer :: model => null ()
     integer :: mode = 0
     type(flavor_t) :: flv_in
     type(flavor_t) :: flv_out
     type(flavor_t) :: flv_rad
     real(default) :: m = 0
     logical :: collinear = .true.
     real(default), dimension(:), allocatable :: qbounds
   contains
   \LA{}SF base: sf test data: TBP\RA{}
  end type sf_test_data_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{944}Output.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{945}\moddef{SF base: sf test data: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => sf_test_data_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{946}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_data_write (data, unit, verbose)
    class(sf_test_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: verbose
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    write (u, "(1x,A)")  "SF test data:"
    write (u, "(3x,A,A)") "model     = ", char (data%model%get_name ())
    write (u, "(3x,A)", advance="no") "incoming  = "
    call data%flv_in%write (u);  write (u, *)
    write (u, "(3x,A)", advance="no") "outgoing  = "
    call data%flv_out%write (u);  write (u, *)
    write (u, "(3x,A)", advance="no") "radiated  = "
    call data%flv_rad%write (u);  write (u, *)
    write (u, "(3x,A," // FMT_19 // ")")  "mass      = ", data%m
    write (u, "(3x,A,L1)")  "collinear = ", data%collinear
    if (.not. data%collinear .and. allocated (data%qbounds)) then
       write (u, "(3x,A," // FMT_19 // ")")  "qmin      = ", data%qbounds(1)
       write (u, "(3x,A," // FMT_19 // ")")  "qmax      = ", data%qbounds(2)
    end if
  end subroutine sf_test_data_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{947}Initialization.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{948}\moddef{SF base: sf test data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => sf_test_data_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{949}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_data_init (data, model, pdg_in, collinear, qbounds, mode)
    class(sf_test_data_t), intent(out) :: data
    class(model_data_t), intent(in), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: pdg_in
    logical, intent(in), optional :: collinear
    real(default), dimension(2), intent(in), optional :: qbounds
    integer, intent(in), optional :: mode
    data%model => model
    if (present (mode))  data%mode = mode
    if (pdg_array_get (pdg_in, 1) /= 25) then
       call msg_fatal ("Test spectrum function: input flavor must be 's'")
    end if
    call data%flv_in%init (25, model)
    data%m = data%flv_in%get_mass ()
    if (present (collinear))  data%collinear = collinear
    call data%flv_out%init (25, model)
    call data%flv_rad%init (25, model)
    if (present (qbounds)) then
       allocate (data%qbounds (2))
       data%qbounds = qbounds
    end if
  end subroutine sf_test_data_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{950}Return the number of parameters: 1 if only consider collinear
splitting, 3 otherwise.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{951}\moddef{SF base: sf test data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_n_par => sf_test_data_get_n_par
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{952}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_test_data_get_n_par (data) result (n)
    class(sf_test_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer :: n
    if (data%collinear) then
       n = 1
    else
       n = 3
    end if
  end function sf_test_data_get_n_par

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{953}Return the outgoing particle PDG code: 25
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{954}\moddef{SF base: sf test data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_pdg_out => sf_test_data_get_pdg_out
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{955}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_data_get_pdg_out (data, pdg_out)
    class(sf_test_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(:), intent(inout) :: pdg_out
    pdg_out(1) = 25
  end subroutine sf_test_data_get_pdg_out

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{956}Allocate the matching interaction.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{957}\moddef{SF base: sf test data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: allocate_sf_int => sf_test_data_allocate_sf_int
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{958}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup

    class(sf_test_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    class(sf_int_t), intent(inout), allocatable :: sf_int
    if (allocated (sf_int)) deallocate (sf_int)
    allocate (sf_test_t :: sf_int)
  end subroutine sf_test_data_allocate_sf_int

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{959}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Interaction}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{960}\moddef{SF base: test types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (sf_int_t) :: sf_test_t
     type(sf_test_data_t), pointer :: data => null ()
     real(default) :: x = 0
   contains
   \LA{}SF base: sf test int: TBP\RA{}
  end type sf_test_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{961}Type string: constant
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{962}\moddef{SF base: sf test int: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: type_string => sf_test_type_string
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{963}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_test_type_string (object) result (string)
    class(sf_test_t), intent(in) :: object
    type(string_t) :: string
    string = "Test"
  end function sf_test_type_string

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{964}Output.  Call the interaction routine after displaying the configuration.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{965}\moddef{SF base: sf test int: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => sf_test_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{966}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_write (object, unit, testflag)
    class(sf_test_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: testflag
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    if (associated (object%data)) then
       call object%data%write (u)
       call object%base_write (u, testflag)
    else
       write (u, "(1x,A)")  "SF test data: [undefined]"
    end if
  end subroutine sf_test_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{967}Initialize.  We know that {\Tt{}data\nwendquote} will be of concrete type
{\Tt{}sf{\_}test{\_}data{\_}t\nwendquote}, but we have to cast this explicitly.

For this implementation, we set the incoming and outgoing masses equal
to the physical particle mass, but keep the radiated mass zero.

Optionally, we can provide minimum and maximum values for the momentum
transfer.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{968}\moddef{SF base: sf test int: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => sf_test_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{969}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_init (sf_int, data)
    class(sf_test_t), intent(out) :: sf_int
    class(sf_data_t), intent(in), target :: data
    type(quantum_numbers_mask_t), dimension(3) :: mask
    type(helicity_t) :: hel0
    type(color_t) :: col0
    type(quantum_numbers_t), dimension(3) :: qn
    mask = quantum_numbers_mask (.false., .false., .false.)
    select type (data)
    type is (sf_test_data_t)
       if (allocated (data%qbounds)) then
          call sf_int%base_init (mask, &
               [data%m**2], [0._default], [data%m**2], &
               [data%qbounds(1)], [data%qbounds(2)])
       else
          call sf_int%base_init (mask, &
               [data%m**2], [0._default], [data%m**2])
       end if
       sf_int%data => data
       call hel0%init (0)
       call col0%init ()
       call qn(1)%init (data%flv_in,  col0, hel0)
       call qn(2)%init (data%flv_rad, col0, hel0)
       call qn(3)%init (data%flv_out, col0, hel0)
       call sf_int%add_state (qn)
       call sf_int%freeze ()
       call sf_int%set_incoming ([1])
       call sf_int%set_radiated ([2])
       call sf_int%set_outgoing ([3])
    end select
    sf_int%status = SF_INITIAL
  end subroutine sf_test_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{970}Set kinematics.  If {\Tt{}map\nwendquote} is unset, the $r$ and $x$ values
coincide, and the Jacobian $f(r)$ is trivial.

If {\Tt{}map\nwendquote} is set, we are asked to provide an efficient mapping.
For the test case, we set $x=r^2$ and consequently $f(r)=2r$.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{971}\moddef{SF base: sf test int: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: complete_kinematics => sf_test_complete_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{972}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_complete_kinematics (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map)
    class(sf_test_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    real(default) :: xb1
    if (map) then
       x(1) = r(1)**2
       f = 2 * r(1)
    else
       x(1) = r(1)
       f = 1
    end if
    xb1 = 1 - x(1)
    if (size (x) == 3)  x(2:3) = r(2:3)
    call sf_int%split_momentum (x, xb1)
    sf_int%x = x(1)
    select case (sf_int%status)
    case (SF_FAILED_KINEMATICS);  f = 0
    end select
  end subroutine sf_test_complete_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{973}Compute inverse kinematics.  Here, we start with the $x$ array and
compute the ``input'' $r$ values and the Jacobian $f$.  After this, we
can set momenta by the same formula as for normal kinematics.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{974}\moddef{SF base: sf test int: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: inverse_kinematics => sf_test_inverse_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{975}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_inverse_kinematics (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map, set_momenta)
    class(sf_test_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    logical, intent(in), optional :: set_momenta
    real(default) :: xb1
    logical :: set_mom
    set_mom = .false.;  if (present (set_momenta))  set_mom = set_momenta
    if (map) then
       r(1) = sqrt (x(1))
       f = 2 * r(1)
    else
       r(1) = x(1)
       f = 1
    end if
    xb1 = 1 - x(1)
    if (size (x) == 3)  r(2:3) = x(2:3)
    rb = 1 - r
    sf_int%x = x(1)
    if (set_mom) then
       call sf_int%split_momentum (x, xb1)
       select case (sf_int%status)
       case (SF_FAILED_KINEMATICS);  f = 0
       end select
    end if
  end subroutine sf_test_inverse_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{976}Apply the structure function.  The matrix element becomes unity and
the application always succeeds.

If the {\Tt{}mode\nwendquote} indicator is one, the matrix element is equal to the
parameter~$x$.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{977}\moddef{SF base: sf test int: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: apply => sf_test_apply
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{978}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_apply (sf_int, scale)
    class(sf_test_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), intent(in) :: scale
    select case (sf_int%data%mode)
    case (0)
       call sf_int%set_matrix_element &
            (cmplx (1._default, kind=default))
    case (1)
       call sf_int%set_matrix_element &
            (cmplx (sf_int%x, kind=default))
    end select
    sf_int%status = SF_EVALUATED
  end subroutine sf_test_apply

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{979}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Test implementation: pair spectrum}
Another template, this time for a incoming particle pair, splitting
into two radiated and two outgoing particles.

\subsubsection{Configuration data}
For simplicity, the spectrum contains two mirror images of the
previous structure-function configuration: the incoming and all
outgoing particles are test scalars.

We have two versions, one with radiated particles, one without.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{980}\moddef{SF base: test types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (sf_data_t) :: sf_test_spectrum_data_t
     class(model_data_t), pointer :: model => null ()
     type(flavor_t) :: flv_in
     type(flavor_t) :: flv_out
     type(flavor_t) :: flv_rad
     logical :: with_radiation = .true.
     real(default) :: m = 0
   contains
   \LA{}SF base: sf test spectrum data: TBP\RA{}
  end type sf_test_spectrum_data_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{981}Output.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{982}\moddef{SF base: sf test spectrum data: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => sf_test_spectrum_data_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{983}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_spectrum_data_write (data, unit, verbose)
    class(sf_test_spectrum_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: verbose
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    write (u, "(1x,A)")  "SF test spectrum data:"
    write (u, "(3x,A,A)") "model     = ", char (data%model%get_name ())
    write (u, "(3x,A)", advance="no") "incoming  = "
    call data%flv_in%write (u);  write (u, *)
    write (u, "(3x,A)", advance="no") "outgoing  = "
    call data%flv_out%write (u);  write (u, *)
    write (u, "(3x,A)", advance="no") "radiated  = "
    call data%flv_rad%write (u);  write (u, *)
    write (u, "(3x,A," // FMT_19 // ")")  "mass      = ", data%m
  end subroutine sf_test_spectrum_data_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{984}Initialization.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{985}\moddef{SF base: sf test spectrum data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => sf_test_spectrum_data_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{986}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_spectrum_data_init (data, model, pdg_in, with_radiation)
    class(sf_test_spectrum_data_t), intent(out) :: data
    class(model_data_t), intent(in), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: pdg_in
    logical, intent(in) :: with_radiation
    data%model => model
    data%with_radiation = with_radiation
    if (pdg_array_get (pdg_in, 1) /= 25) then
       call msg_fatal ("Test structure function: input flavor must be 's'")
    end if
    call data%flv_in%init (25, model)
    data%m = data%flv_in%get_mass ()
    call data%flv_out%init (25, model)
    if (with_radiation) then
       call data%flv_rad%init (25, model)
    end if
  end subroutine sf_test_spectrum_data_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{987}Return the number of parameters: 2, since we have only collinear
splitting here.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{988}\moddef{SF base: sf test spectrum data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_n_par => sf_test_spectrum_data_get_n_par
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{989}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_test_spectrum_data_get_n_par (data) result (n)
    class(sf_test_spectrum_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer :: n
    n = 2
  end function sf_test_spectrum_data_get_n_par

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{990}Return the outgoing particle PDG codes: 25
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{991}\moddef{SF base: sf test spectrum data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_pdg_out => sf_test_spectrum_data_get_pdg_out
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{992}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_spectrum_data_get_pdg_out (data, pdg_out)
    class(sf_test_spectrum_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(:), intent(inout) :: pdg_out
    pdg_out(1) = 25
    pdg_out(2) = 25
  end subroutine sf_test_spectrum_data_get_pdg_out

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{993}Allocate the matching interaction.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{994}\moddef{SF base: sf test spectrum data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup

       sf_test_spectrum_data_allocate_sf_int

    class(sf_test_spectrum_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    class(sf_int_t), intent(inout), allocatable :: sf_int
    allocate (sf_test_spectrum_t :: sf_int)
  end subroutine sf_test_spectrum_data_allocate_sf_int

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{996}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Interaction}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{997}\moddef{SF base: test types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (sf_int_t) :: sf_test_spectrum_t
     type(sf_test_spectrum_data_t), pointer :: data => null ()
   contains
   \LA{}SF base: sf test spectrum: TBP\RA{}
  end type sf_test_spectrum_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{998}\moddef{SF base: sf test spectrum: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: type_string => sf_test_spectrum_type_string
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{999}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_test_spectrum_type_string (object) result (string)
    class(sf_test_spectrum_t), intent(in) :: object
    type(string_t) :: string
    string = "Test Spectrum"
  end function sf_test_spectrum_type_string

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1000}Output.  Call the interaction routine after displaying the configuration.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1001}\moddef{SF base: sf test spectrum: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => sf_test_spectrum_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1002}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_spectrum_write (object, unit, testflag)
    class(sf_test_spectrum_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: testflag
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    if (associated (object%data)) then
       call object%data%write (u)
       call object%base_write (u, testflag)
    else
       write (u, "(1x,A)")  "SF test spectrum data: [undefined]"
    end if
  end subroutine sf_test_spectrum_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1003}Initialize.  We know that {\Tt{}data\nwendquote} will be of concrete type
{\Tt{}sf{\_}test{\_}spectrum{\_}data{\_}t\nwendquote}, but we have to cast this explicitly.

For this implementation, we set the incoming and outgoing masses equal
to the physical particle mass, but keep the radiated mass zero.

Optionally, we can provide minimum and maximum values for the momentum
transfer.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1004}\moddef{SF base: sf test spectrum: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => sf_test_spectrum_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1005}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_spectrum_init (sf_int, data)
    class(sf_test_spectrum_t), intent(out) :: sf_int
    class(sf_data_t), intent(in), target :: data
    type(quantum_numbers_mask_t), dimension(6) :: mask
    type(helicity_t) :: hel0
    type(color_t) :: col0
    type(quantum_numbers_t), dimension(6) :: qn
    mask = quantum_numbers_mask (.false., .false., .false.)
    select type (data)
    type is (sf_test_spectrum_data_t)
       if (data%with_radiation) then
          call sf_int%base_init (mask(1:6), &
               [data%m**2, data%m**2], &
               [0._default, 0._default], &
               [data%m**2, data%m**2])
          sf_int%data => data
          call hel0%init (0)
          call col0%init ()
          call qn(1)%init (data%flv_in,  col0, hel0)
          call qn(2)%init (data%flv_in,  col0, hel0)
          call qn(3)%init (data%flv_rad, col0, hel0)
          call qn(4)%init (data%flv_rad, col0, hel0)
          call qn(5)%init (data%flv_out, col0, hel0)
          call qn(6)%init (data%flv_out, col0, hel0)
          call sf_int%add_state (qn(1:6))
          call sf_int%set_incoming ([1,2])
          call sf_int%set_radiated ([3,4])
          call sf_int%set_outgoing ([5,6])
       else
          call sf_int%base_init (mask(1:4), &
               [data%m**2, data%m**2], &
               [real(default) :: ], &
               [data%m**2, data%m**2])
          sf_int%data => data
          call hel0%init (0)
          call col0%init ()
          call qn(1)%init (data%flv_in,  col0, hel0)
          call qn(2)%init (data%flv_in,  col0, hel0)
          call qn(3)%init (data%flv_out, col0, hel0)
          call qn(4)%init (data%flv_out, col0, hel0)
          call sf_int%add_state (qn(1:4))
          call sf_int%set_incoming ([1,2])
          call sf_int%set_outgoing ([3,4])
       end if
       call sf_int%freeze ()
    end select
    sf_int%status = SF_INITIAL
  end subroutine sf_test_spectrum_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1006}Set kinematics.  If {\Tt{}map\nwendquote} is unset, the $r$ and $x$ values
coincide, and the Jacobian $f(r)$ is trivial.

If {\Tt{}map\nwendquote} is set, we are asked to provide an efficient mapping.
For the test case, we set $x=r^2$ (as above) for both $x$ parameters
and consequently $f(r)=4r_1r_2$.

\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1007}\moddef{SF base: sf test spectrum: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: complete_kinematics => sf_test_spectrum_complete_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1008}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_spectrum_complete_kinematics (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map)
    class(sf_test_spectrum_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    real(default), dimension(2) :: xb1
    if (map) then
       x = r**2
       f = 4 * r(1) * r(2)
    else
       x = r
       f = 1
    end if
    if (sf_int%data%with_radiation) then
       xb1 = 1 - x
       call sf_int%split_momenta (x, xb1)
    else
       call sf_int%reduce_momenta (x)
    end if
    select case (sf_int%status)
    case (SF_FAILED_KINEMATICS);  f = 0
    end select
  end subroutine sf_test_spectrum_complete_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1009}Compute inverse kinematics.  Here, we start with the $x$ array and
compute the ``input'' $r$ values and the Jacobian $f$.  After this, we
can set momenta by the same formula as for normal kinematics.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1010}\moddef{SF base: sf test spectrum: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: inverse_kinematics => sf_test_spectrum_inverse_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1011}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_spectrum_inverse_kinematics &
       (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map, set_momenta)
    class(sf_test_spectrum_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    logical, intent(in), optional :: set_momenta
    real(default), dimension(2) :: xb1
    logical :: set_mom
    set_mom = .false.;  if (present (set_momenta))  set_mom = set_momenta
    if (map) then
       r = sqrt (x)
       f = 4 * r(1) * r(2)
    else
       r = x
       f = 1
    end if
    rb = 1 - r
    if (set_mom)  then
       if (sf_int%data%with_radiation) then
          xb1 = 1 - x
          call sf_int%split_momenta (x, xb1)
       else
          call sf_int%reduce_momenta (x)
       end if
       select case (sf_int%status)
       case (SF_FAILED_KINEMATICS);  f = 0
       end select
    end if
  end subroutine sf_test_spectrum_inverse_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1012}Apply the structure function.  The matrix element becomes unity and
the application always succeeds.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1013}\moddef{SF base: sf test spectrum: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: apply => sf_test_spectrum_apply
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1014}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_spectrum_apply (sf_int, scale)
    class(sf_test_spectrum_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), intent(in) :: scale
    call sf_int%set_matrix_element &
         (cmplx (1._default, kind=default))
    sf_int%status = SF_EVALUATED
  end subroutine sf_test_spectrum_apply

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1015}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Test implementation: generator spectrum}
A generator for two beams, no radiation (for simplicity).

\subsubsection{Configuration data}
For simplicity, the spectrum contains two mirror images of the
previous structure-function configuration: the incoming and all
outgoing particles are test scalars.

We have two versions, one with radiated particles, one without.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1016}\moddef{SF base: test types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (sf_data_t) :: sf_test_generator_data_t
     class(model_data_t), pointer :: model => null ()
     type(flavor_t) :: flv_in
     type(flavor_t) :: flv_out
     type(flavor_t) :: flv_rad
     real(default) :: m = 0
   contains
   \LA{}SF base: sf test generator data: TBP\RA{}
  end type sf_test_generator_data_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1017}Output.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1018}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator data: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => sf_test_generator_data_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1019}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_generator_data_write (data, unit, verbose)
    class(sf_test_generator_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: verbose
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    write (u, "(1x,A)")  "SF test generator data:"
    write (u, "(3x,A,A)") "model     = ", char (data%model%get_name ())
    write (u, "(3x,A)", advance="no") "incoming  = "
    call data%flv_in%write (u);  write (u, *)
    write (u, "(3x,A)", advance="no") "outgoing  = "
    call data%flv_out%write (u);  write (u, *)
    write (u, "(3x,A," // FMT_19 // ")")  "mass      = ", data%m
  end subroutine sf_test_generator_data_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1020}Initialization.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1021}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => sf_test_generator_data_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1022}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_generator_data_init (data, model, pdg_in)
    class(sf_test_generator_data_t), intent(out) :: data
    class(model_data_t), intent(in), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: pdg_in
    data%model => model
    if (pdg_array_get (pdg_in, 1) /= 25) then
       call msg_fatal ("Test generator: input flavor must be 's'")
    end if
    call data%flv_in%init (25, model)
    data%m = data%flv_in%get_mass ()
    call data%flv_out%init (25, model)
  end subroutine sf_test_generator_data_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1023}This structure function is a generator.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1024}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: is_generator => sf_test_generator_data_is_generator
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1025}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_test_generator_data_is_generator (data) result (flag)
    class(sf_test_generator_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    logical :: flag
    flag = .true.
  end function sf_test_generator_data_is_generator

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1026}Return the number of parameters: 2, since we have only collinear
splitting here.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1027}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_n_par => sf_test_generator_data_get_n_par
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1028}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_test_generator_data_get_n_par (data) result (n)
    class(sf_test_generator_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer :: n
    n = 2
  end function sf_test_generator_data_get_n_par

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1029}Return the outgoing particle PDG codes: 25
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1030}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_pdg_out => sf_test_generator_data_get_pdg_out
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1031}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_generator_data_get_pdg_out (data, pdg_out)
    class(sf_test_generator_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(:), intent(inout) :: pdg_out
    pdg_out(1) = 25
    pdg_out(2) = 25
  end subroutine sf_test_generator_data_get_pdg_out

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1032}Allocate the matching interaction.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1033}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: allocate_sf_int => &
       sf_test_generator_data_allocate_sf_int
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1034}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_generator_data_allocate_sf_int (data, sf_int)
    class(sf_test_generator_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    class(sf_int_t), intent(inout), allocatable :: sf_int
    allocate (sf_test_generator_t :: sf_int)
  end subroutine sf_test_generator_data_allocate_sf_int

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1035}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Interaction}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1036}\moddef{SF base: test types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (sf_int_t) :: sf_test_generator_t
     type(sf_test_generator_data_t), pointer :: data => null ()
   contains
   \LA{}SF base: sf test generator: TBP\RA{}
  end type sf_test_generator_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1037}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: type_string => sf_test_generator_type_string
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1038}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_test_generator_type_string (object) result (string)
    class(sf_test_generator_t), intent(in) :: object
    type(string_t) :: string
    string = "Test Generator"
  end function sf_test_generator_type_string

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1039}Output.  Call the interaction routine after displaying the configuration.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1040}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => sf_test_generator_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1041}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_generator_write (object, unit, testflag)
    class(sf_test_generator_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: testflag
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    if (associated (object%data)) then
       call object%data%write (u)
       call object%base_write (u, testflag)
    else
       write (u, "(1x,A)")  "SF test generator data: [undefined]"
    end if
  end subroutine sf_test_generator_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1042}Initialize.  We know that {\Tt{}data\nwendquote} will be of concrete type
{\Tt{}sf{\_}test{\_}generator{\_}data{\_}t\nwendquote}, but we have to cast this explicitly.

For this implementation, we set the incoming and outgoing masses equal
to the physical particle mass.  No radiation.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1043}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => sf_test_generator_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1044}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_generator_init (sf_int, data)
    class(sf_test_generator_t), intent(out) :: sf_int
    class(sf_data_t), intent(in), target :: data
    type(quantum_numbers_mask_t), dimension(4) :: mask
    type(helicity_t) :: hel0
    type(color_t) :: col0
    type(quantum_numbers_t), dimension(4) :: qn
    mask = quantum_numbers_mask (.false., .false., .false.)
    select type (data)
    type is (sf_test_generator_data_t)
       call sf_int%base_init (mask(1:4), &
            [data%m**2, data%m**2], &
            [real(default) :: ], &
            [data%m**2, data%m**2])
       sf_int%data => data
       call hel0%init (0)
       call col0%init ()
       call qn(1)%init (data%flv_in,  col0, hel0)
       call qn(2)%init (data%flv_in,  col0, hel0)
       call qn(3)%init (data%flv_out, col0, hel0)
       call qn(4)%init (data%flv_out, col0, hel0)
       call sf_int%add_state (qn(1:4))
       call sf_int%set_incoming ([1,2])
       call sf_int%set_outgoing ([3,4])
       call sf_int%freeze ()
    end select
    sf_int%status = SF_INITIAL
  end subroutine sf_test_generator_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1045}This structure function is a generator.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1046}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: is_generator => sf_test_generator_is_generator
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1047}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function sf_test_generator_is_generator (sf_int) result (flag)
    class(sf_test_generator_t), intent(in) :: sf_int
    logical :: flag
    flag = sf_int%data%is_generator ()
  end function sf_test_generator_is_generator

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1048}Generate free parameters.  This mock generator always produces the
nubmers 0.8 and 0.5.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1049}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: generate_free => sf_test_generator_generate_free
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1050}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_generator_generate_free (sf_int, r, rb,  x_free)
    class(sf_test_generator_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: r, rb
    real(default), intent(inout) :: x_free
    r = [0.8, 0.5]
    rb= 1 - r
    x_free = x_free * product (r)
  end subroutine sf_test_generator_generate_free

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1051}Recover momentum fractions.  Since the x values are free, we also set the {\Tt{}x{\_}free\nwendquote} parameter.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1052}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: recover_x => sf_test_generator_recover_x
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1053}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_generator_recover_x (sf_int, x, x_free)
    class(sf_test_generator_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: x
    real(default), intent(inout), optional :: x_free
    call sf_int%base_recover_x (x)
    if (present (x_free))  x_free = x_free * product (x)
  end subroutine sf_test_generator_recover_x

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1054}Set kinematics.  Since this is a generator, just transfer input to output.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1055}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: complete_kinematics => sf_test_generator_complete_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1056}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_generator_complete_kinematics (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map)
    class(sf_test_generator_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    x = r
    f = 1
    call sf_int%reduce_momenta (x)
  end subroutine sf_test_generator_complete_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1057}Compute inverse kinematics.  Here, we start with the $x$ array and
compute the ``input'' $r$ values and the Jacobian $f$.  After this, we
can set momenta by the same formula as for normal kinematics.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1058}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: inverse_kinematics => sf_test_generator_inverse_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1059}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_generator_inverse_kinematics &
       (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map, set_momenta)
    class(sf_test_generator_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    logical, intent(in), optional :: set_momenta
    logical :: set_mom
    set_mom = .false.;  if (present (set_momenta))  set_mom = set_momenta
    r = x
    rb= 1 - x
    f = 1
    if (set_mom)  call sf_int%reduce_momenta (x)
  end subroutine sf_test_generator_inverse_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1060}Apply the structure function.  The matrix element becomes unity and
the application always succeeds.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1061}\moddef{SF base: sf test generator: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: apply => sf_test_generator_apply
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1062}\moddef{SF base: test auxiliary}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_test_generator_apply (sf_int, scale)
    class(sf_test_generator_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), intent(in) :: scale
    call sf_int%set_matrix_element &
         (cmplx (1._default, kind=default))
    sf_int%status = SF_EVALUATED
  end subroutine sf_test_generator_apply

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1063}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Test structure function data}
Construct and display a test structure function data object.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1064}\moddef{SF base: execute tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_base_1, "sf_base_1", &
       "structure function configuration", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1065}\moddef{SF base: test declarations}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_base_1
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1066}\moddef{SF base: tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_base_1 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t) :: pdg_in
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(1) :: pdg_out
    integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: pdg1
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable :: data

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_base_1"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and display &
         &test structure function data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_test ()
    pdg_in = 25

    allocate (sf_test_data_t :: data)
    select type (data)
    type is (sf_test_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in)
    end select

    call data%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(1x,A)")  "Outgoing particle code:"
    call data%get_pdg_out (pdg_out)
    pdg1 = pdg_out(1)
    write (u, "(2x,99(1x,I0))")  pdg1

    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_base_1"

  end subroutine sf_base_1

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1067}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Test and probe structure function}
Construct and display a structure function object based on the test
structure function.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1068}\moddef{SF base: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_base_2, "sf_base_2", &
       "structure function instance", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1069}\moddef{SF base: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_base_2
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1070}\moddef{SF base: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_base_2 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(flavor_t) :: flv
    type(pdg_array_t) :: pdg_in
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable, target :: data
    class(sf_int_t), allocatable :: sf_int
    type(vector4_t) :: k
    type(vector4_t), dimension(2) :: q
    real(default) :: E
    real(default), dimension(:), allocatable :: r, rb, x
    real(default) :: f

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_base_2"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and fill &
         &test structure function object"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize configuration data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_test ()
    pdg_in = 25
    call flv%init (25, model)

    call reset_interaction_counter ()

    allocate (sf_test_data_t :: data)
    select type (data)
    type is (sf_test_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in)
    end select

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize structure-function object"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call data%allocate_sf_int (sf_int)
    call sf_int%init (data)
    call sf_int%set_beam_index ([1])

    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize incoming momentum with E=500"
    write (u, "(A)")
    E = 500
    k = vector4_moving (E, sqrt (E**2 - flv%get_mass ()**2), 3)
    call vector4_write (k, u)
    call sf_int%seed_kinematics ([k])

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set kinematics for x=0"
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (r (data%get_n_par ()))
    allocate (rb(size (r)))
    allocate (x (size (r)))

    r = 0
    rb = 1 - r
    call sf_int%complete_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.false.)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set kinematics for x=1"
    write (u, "(A)")

    r = 1
    rb = 1 - r
    call sf_int%complete_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.false.)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set kinematics for x=0.5"
    write (u, "(A)")

    r = 0.5_default
    rb = 1 - r
    call sf_int%complete_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.false.)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set kinematics with mapping for r=0.8"
    write (u, "(A)")

    r = 0.8_default
    rb = 1 - r
    call sf_int%complete_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.true.)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Recover x from momenta"
    write (u, "(A)")

    q = sf_int%get_momenta (outgoing=.true.)
    call sf_int%final ()
    deallocate (sf_int)

    call data%allocate_sf_int (sf_int)
    call sf_int%init (data)
    call sf_int%set_beam_index ([1])

    call sf_int%seed_kinematics ([k])
    call sf_int%set_momenta (q, outgoing=.true.)
    call sf_int%recover_x (x)

    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Compute inverse kinematics for x=0.64 and evaluate"
    write (u, "(A)")

    x = 0.64_default
    call sf_int%inverse_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.true.)
    call sf_int%apply (scale=0._default)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "r =", r
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call sf_int%final ()
    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_base_2"

  end subroutine sf_base_2

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_base_3"

    call sf_int%write (u)

    call sf_int%complete_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.false.)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Recover x and r"

    sf_int%mo2 = sf_int%mi2

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1079}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Pair spectrum}
Construct and display a structure function object for a pair spectrum
(a structure function involving two particles simultaneously).
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1080}\moddef{SF base: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_base_5, "sf_base_5", &
       "pair spectrum with radiation", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1081}\moddef{SF base: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_base_5
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1082}\moddef{SF base: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_base_5 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t) :: pdg_in
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2) :: pdg_out
    integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: pdg1, pdg2
    type(flavor_t) :: flv
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable, target :: data
    class(sf_int_t), allocatable :: sf_int
    type(vector4_t), dimension(2) :: k
    type(vector4_t), dimension(4) :: q
    real(default) :: E
    real(default), dimension(:), allocatable :: r, rb, x
    real(default) :: f

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_base_5"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and fill &
         &a pair spectrum object"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize configuration data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_test ()
    call flv%init (25, model)
    pdg_in = 25

    call reset_interaction_counter ()

    allocate (sf_test_spectrum_data_t :: data)
    select type (data)
    type is (sf_test_spectrum_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in, with_radiation=.true.)
    end select

    write (u, "(1x,A)")  "Outgoing particle codes:"
    call data%get_pdg_out (pdg_out)
    pdg1 = pdg_out(1)
    pdg2 = pdg_out(2)
    write (u, "(2x,99(1x,I0))")  pdg1, pdg2

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize spectrum object"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call data%allocate_sf_int (sf_int)
    call sf_int%init (data)

    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize incoming momenta with sqrts=1000"

    E = 500
    k(1) = vector4_moving (E, sqrt (E**2 - flv%get_mass ()**2), 3)
    k(2) = vector4_moving (E, sqrt (E**2 - flv%get_mass ()**2), 3)
    call sf_int%seed_kinematics (k)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set kinematics for x=0.4,0.8"
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (r (data%get_n_par ()))
    allocate (rb(size (r)))
    allocate (x (size (r)))

    r = [0.4_default, 0.8_default]
    rb = 1 - r
    call sf_int%complete_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.false.)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set kinematics with mapping for r=0.6,0.8"
    write (u, "(A)")

    r = [0.6_default, 0.8_default]
    rb = 1 - r
    call sf_int%complete_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.true.)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Recover x from momenta"
    write (u, "(A)")

    q = sf_int%get_momenta (outgoing=.true.)
    call sf_int%final ()
    deallocate (sf_int)

    call reset_interaction_counter ()
    call data%allocate_sf_int (sf_int)
    call sf_int%init (data)

    call sf_int%seed_kinematics (k)
    call sf_int%set_momenta (q, outgoing=.true.)
    call sf_int%recover_x (x)
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Compute inverse kinematics for x=0.36,0.64 &
         &and evaluate"
    write (u, "(A)")

    x = [0.36_default, 0.64_default]
    call sf_int%inverse_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.true.)
    call sf_int%apply (scale=0._default)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "r =", r
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call sf_int%final ()
    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_base_5"

  end subroutine sf_base_5

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1083}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Pair spectrum without radiation}
Construct and display a structure function object for a pair spectrum
(a structure function involving two particles simultaneously).
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1084}\moddef{SF base: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_base_6, "sf_base_6", &
       "pair spectrum without radiation", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1085}\moddef{SF base: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_base_6
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1086}\moddef{SF base: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_base_6 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t) :: pdg_in
    type(flavor_t) :: flv
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable, target :: data
    class(sf_int_t), allocatable :: sf_int
    type(vector4_t), dimension(2) :: k
    type(vector4_t), dimension(2) :: q
    real(default) :: E
    real(default), dimension(:), allocatable :: r, rb, x
    real(default) :: f

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_base_6"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and fill &
         &a pair spectrum object"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize configuration data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_test ()
    call flv%init (25, model)
    pdg_in = 25

    call reset_interaction_counter ()

    allocate (sf_test_spectrum_data_t :: data)
    select type (data)
    type is (sf_test_spectrum_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in, with_radiation=.false.)
    end select

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize spectrum object"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call data%allocate_sf_int (sf_int)
    call sf_int%init (data)

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize incoming momenta with sqrts=1000"

    E = 500
    k(1) = vector4_moving (E, sqrt (E**2 - flv%get_mass ()**2), 3)
    k(2) = vector4_moving (E, sqrt (E**2 - flv%get_mass ()**2), 3)
    call sf_int%seed_kinematics (k)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set kinematics for x=0.4,0.8"
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (r (data%get_n_par ()))
    allocate (rb(size (r)))
    allocate (x (size (r)))

    r = [0.4_default, 0.8_default]
    rb = 1 - r
    call sf_int%complete_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.false.)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Recover x from momenta"
    write (u, "(A)")

    q = sf_int%get_momenta (outgoing=.true.)
    call sf_int%final ()
    deallocate (sf_int)

    call reset_interaction_counter ()
    call data%allocate_sf_int (sf_int)
    call sf_int%init (data)

    call sf_int%seed_kinematics (k)
    call sf_int%set_momenta (q, outgoing=.true.)
    call sf_int%recover_x (x)
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Compute inverse kinematics for x=0.4,0.8 &
         &and evaluate"
    write (u, "(A)")

    x = [0.4_default, 0.8_default]
    call sf_int%inverse_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.false.)
    call sf_int%apply (scale=0._default)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "r =", r
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call sf_int%final ()
    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_base_6"

  end subroutine sf_base_6

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1087}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Direct access to structure function}
Probe a structure function directly.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1088}\moddef{SF base: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_base_7, "sf_base_7", &
       "direct access", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1089}\moddef{SF base: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_base_7
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1090}\moddef{SF base: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_base_7 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t) :: pdg_in
    type(flavor_t) :: flv
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable, target :: data
    class(sf_int_t), allocatable :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), allocatable :: value

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_base_7"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: check direct access method"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize configuration data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_test ()
    call flv%init (25, model)
    pdg_in = 25

    call reset_interaction_counter ()

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize structure-function object"
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (sf_test_data_t :: data)
    select type (data)
    type is (sf_test_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in)
    end select

    call data%allocate_sf_int (sf_int)
    call sf_int%init (data)

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Probe structure function: states"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "n_states = ", sf_int%get_n_states ()
    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "n_in     = ", sf_int%get_n_in ()
    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "n_rad    = ", sf_int%get_n_rad ()
    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "n_out    = ", sf_int%get_n_out ()
    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)", advance="no")  "state(1)  = "
    call quantum_numbers_write (sf_int%get_state (1), u)
    write (u, *)

    allocate (value (sf_int%get_n_states ()))
    call sf_int%compute_values (value, &
         E=[500._default], x=[0.5_default], xb=[0.5_default], scale=0._default)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)", advance="no")  "value (E=500, x=0.5) ="
    write (u, "(9(1x," // FMT_19 // "))")  value

    call sf_int%compute_values (value, &
         x=[0.1_default], xb=[0.9_default], scale=0._default)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)", advance="no")  "value (E=500, x=0.1) ="
    write (u, "(9(1x," // FMT_19 // "))")  value


    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize spectrum object"
    write (u, "(A)")

    deallocate (value)
    call sf_int%final ()
    deallocate (sf_int)
    deallocate (data)

    allocate (sf_test_spectrum_data_t :: data)
    select type (data)
    type is (sf_test_spectrum_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in, with_radiation=.false.)
    end select

    call data%allocate_sf_int (sf_int)
    call sf_int%init (data)

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Probe spectrum: states"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "n_states = ", sf_int%get_n_states ()
    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "n_in     = ", sf_int%get_n_in ()
    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "n_rad    = ", sf_int%get_n_rad ()
    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "n_out    = ", sf_int%get_n_out ()
    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)", advance="no")  "state(1)  = "
    call quantum_numbers_write (sf_int%get_state (1), u)
    write (u, *)

    allocate (value (sf_int%get_n_states ()))
    call sf_int%compute_value (1, value(1), &
         E = [500._default, 500._default], &
         x = [0.5_default, 0.6_default], &
         xb= [0.5_default, 0.4_default], &
         scale = 0._default)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)", advance="no")  "value (E=500,500, x=0.5,0.6) ="
    write (u, "(9(1x," // FMT_19 // "))")  value

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call sf_int%final ()
    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_base_7"

  end subroutine sf_base_7

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1091}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Structure function chain configuration}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1092}\moddef{SF base: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_base_8, "sf_base_8", &
       "structure function chain configuration", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1093}\moddef{SF base: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_base_8
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1094}\moddef{SF base: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_base_8 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(flavor_t) :: flv
    type(pdg_array_t) :: pdg_in
    type(beam_data_t), target :: beam_data
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable, target :: data_strfun
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable, target :: data_spectrum
    type(sf_config_t), dimension(:), allocatable :: sf_config
    type(sf_chain_t) :: sf_chain

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_base_8"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: set up a structure-function chain"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize configuration data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_test ()
    call flv%init (25, model)
    pdg_in = 25

    call reset_interaction_counter ()

    call beam_data%init_sqrts (1000._default, [flv, flv])

    allocate (sf_test_data_t :: data_strfun)
    select type (data_strfun)
    type is (sf_test_data_t)
       call data_strfun%init (model, pdg_in)
    end select

    allocate (sf_test_spectrum_data_t :: data_spectrum)
    select type (data_spectrum)
    type is (sf_test_spectrum_data_t)
       call data_spectrum%init (model, pdg_in, with_radiation=.true.)
    end select

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set up chain with beams only"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call sf_chain%init (beam_data)
    call write_separator (u, 2)
    call sf_chain%write (u)
    call write_separator (u, 2)
    call sf_chain%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set up chain with structure function"
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (sf_config (1))
    call sf_config(1)%init ([1], data_strfun)
    call sf_chain%init (beam_data, sf_config)

    call write_separator (u, 2)
    call sf_chain%write (u)
    call write_separator (u, 2)
    call sf_chain%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set up chain with spectrum and structure function"
    write (u, "(A)")

    deallocate (sf_config)
    allocate (sf_config (2))
    call sf_config(1)%init ([1,2], data_spectrum)
    call sf_config(2)%init ([2], data_strfun)
    call sf_chain%init (beam_data, sf_config)

    call write_separator (u, 2)
    call sf_chain%write (u)
    call write_separator (u, 2)
    call sf_chain%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_base_8"

  end subroutine sf_base_8
