\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1360}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Data type}
The {\Tt{}norm\nwendquote} is unity if the total cross section should be normalized
to one, and $\sqrt{s}$ if it should be normalized to the total
energy.  In the latter case, the differential distribution
$d\sigma/d\sqrt{\hat s}$ coincides with the partonic cross section
$\hat\sigma$ as a function of $\sqrt{\hat s}$.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1361}\moddef{SF escan: public}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: escan_data_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1362}\moddef{SF escan: types}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends(sf_data_t) :: escan_data_t
     private
     type(flavor_t), dimension(:,:), allocatable :: flv_in
     integer, dimension(2) :: n_flv = 0
     real(default) :: norm = 1
   contains
   \LA{}SF escan: escan data: TBP\RA{}
  end type escan_data_t

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1363} %def escan_data_t
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1364}\moddef{SF escan: escan data: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => escan_data_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1365}\moddef{SF escan: procedures}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine escan_data_init (data, model, pdg_in, norm)
    class(escan_data_t), intent(out) :: data
    class(model_data_t), intent(in), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2), intent(in) :: pdg_in
    real(default), intent(in), optional :: norm
    real(default), dimension(2) :: m2
    integer :: i, j
    data%n_flv = pdg_array_get_length (pdg_in)
    allocate (data%flv_in (maxval (data%n_flv), 2))
    do i = 1, 2
       do j = 1, data%n_flv(i)
          call data%flv_in(j, i)%init (pdg_array_get (pdg_in(i), j), model)
       end do
    end do
    m2 = data%flv_in(1,:)%get_mass ()
    do i = 1, 2
       if (.not. any (nearly_equal (data%flv_in(1:data%n_flv(i),i)%get_mass (), m2(i)))) then
          call msg_fatal ("Energy scan: incoming particle mass must be uniform")
       end if
    end do
    if (present (norm))  data%norm = norm
  end subroutine escan_data_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1366}Output
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1367}\moddef{SF escan: escan data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => escan_data_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1368}\moddef{SF escan: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine escan_data_write (data, unit, verbose)
    class(escan_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: verbose
    integer :: u, i, j
    u = given_output_unit (unit);  if (u < 0)  return
    write (u, "(1x,A)") "Energy-scan data:"
    write (u, "(3x,A)", advance="no")  "prt_in = "
    do i = 1, 2
       if (i > 1)  write (u, "(',',1x)", advance="no")
       do j = 1, data%n_flv(i)
          if (j > 1)  write (u, "(':')", advance="no")
          write (u, "(A)", advance="no")  char (data%flv_in(j,i)%get_name ())
       end do
    end do
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(3x,A," // FMT_12 // ")")  "norm   =", data%norm
  end subroutine escan_data_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1369}Kinematics is completely collinear, hence there is only one
parameter for a pair spectrum.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1370}\moddef{SF escan: escan data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_n_par => escan_data_get_n_par
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1371}\moddef{SF escan: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function escan_data_get_n_par (data) result (n)
    class(escan_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer :: n
    n = 1
  end function escan_data_get_n_par

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1372}Return the outgoing particles PDG codes. This is always the same as
the incoming particle, where we use two indices for the two beams.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1373}\moddef{SF escan: escan data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_pdg_out => escan_data_get_pdg_out
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1374}\moddef{SF escan: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine escan_data_get_pdg_out (data, pdg_out)
    class(escan_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(:), intent(inout) :: pdg_out
    integer :: i, n
    n = 2
    do i = 1, n
       pdg_out(i) = data%flv_in(1:data%n_flv(i),i)%get_pdg ()
    end do
  end subroutine escan_data_get_pdg_out

\eatline

    class(escan_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    class(sf_int_t), intent(inout), allocatable :: sf_int

  end subroutine escan_data_allocate_sf_int

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1378}\nwdocspar
\subsection{The Energy-scan object}
This is a spectrum, not a radiation.  We create an interaction with
two incoming and two outgoing particles, flavor, color, and helicity
being carried through. $x$ nevertheless is only one-dimensional, as we
are always using only one beam parameter.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1379}\moddef{SF escan: types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (sf_int_t) :: escan_t
     type(escan_data_t), pointer :: data => null ()
   contains
   \LA{}SF escan: escan: TBP\RA{}
  end type escan_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1380}Type string: for the energy scan this is just a dummy function.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1381}\moddef{SF escan: escan: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: type_string => escan_type_string
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1382}\moddef{SF escan: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function escan_type_string (object) result (string)
    class(escan_t), intent(in) :: object
    type(string_t) :: string
    if (associated (object%data)) then
       string = "Escan: energy scan"
    else
       string = "Escan: [undefined]"
    end if
  end function escan_type_string

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1383}Output.  Call the interaction routine after displaying the configuration.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1384}\moddef{SF escan: escan: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => escan_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1385}\moddef{SF escan: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine escan_write (object, unit, testflag)
    class(escan_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: testflag
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    if (associated (object%data)) then
       call object%data%write (u)
       call object%base_write (u, testflag)
    else
       write (u, "(1x,A)")  "Energy scan data: [undefined]"
    end if
  end subroutine escan_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1386}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1387}\moddef{SF escan: escan: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => escan_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1388}\moddef{SF escan: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine escan_init (sf_int, data)
    class(escan_t), intent(out) :: sf_int
    class(sf_data_t), intent(in), target :: data
    type(quantum_numbers_mask_t), dimension(4) :: mask
    integer, dimension(4) :: hel_lock
    real(default), dimension(2) :: m2
    real(default), dimension(0) :: mr2
    type(quantum_numbers_t), dimension(4) :: qn_fc, qn_hel, qn
    type(polarization_t), target :: pol1, pol2
    type(polarization_iterator_t) :: it_hel1, it_hel2
    integer :: j1, j2
    select type (data)
    type is (escan_data_t)
       hel_lock = [3, 4, 1, 2]
       m2 = data%flv_in(1,:)%get_mass ()
       call sf_int%base_init (mask, m2, mr2, m2, hel_lock = hel_lock)
       sf_int%data => data
       do j1 = 1, data%n_flv(1)
          call qn_fc(1)%init ( &
               flv = data%flv_in(j1,1), &
               col = color_from_flavor (data%flv_in(j1,1)))
          call qn_fc(3)%init ( &
               flv = data%flv_in(j1,1), &
               col = color_from_flavor (data%flv_in(j1,1)))
          call pol1%init_generic (data%flv_in(j1,1))
          do j2 = 1, data%n_flv(2)
             call qn_fc(2)%init ( &
                  flv = data%flv_in(j2,2), &
                  col = color_from_flavor (data%flv_in(j2,2)))
             call qn_fc(4)%init ( &
                  flv = data%flv_in(j2,2), &
                  col = color_from_flavor (data%flv_in(j2,2)))
             call pol2%init_generic (data%flv_in(j2,2))
             call it_hel1%init (pol1)
             do while (it_hel1%is_valid ())
                qn_hel(1) = it_hel1%get_quantum_numbers ()
                qn_hel(3) = it_hel1%get_quantum_numbers ()
                call it_hel2%init (pol2)
                do while (it_hel2%is_valid ())
                   qn_hel(2) = it_hel2%get_quantum_numbers ()
                   qn_hel(4) = it_hel2%get_quantum_numbers ()
                   qn = qn_hel .merge. qn_fc
                   call sf_int%add_state (qn)
                   call it_hel2%advance ()
                end do
                call it_hel1%advance ()
             end do
             ! call pol2%final ()
          end do
          ! call pol1%final ()
       end do
       call sf_int%set_incoming ([1,2])
       call sf_int%set_outgoing ([3,4])
       call sf_int%freeze ()
       sf_int%status = SF_INITIAL
    end select
  end subroutine escan_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1389}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Kinematics}
Set kinematics.  We have a single parameter, but reduce both beams.
The {\Tt{}map\nwendquote} flag is ignored.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1390}\moddef{SF escan: escan: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: complete_kinematics => escan_complete_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1391}\moddef{SF escan: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine escan_complete_kinematics (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map)
    class(escan_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default) :: sqrt_x
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    x = r
    sqrt_x = sqrt (x(1))
    if (sqrt_x > 0) then
       f = 1 / (2 * sqrt_x)
    else
       f = 0
       sf_int%status = SF_FAILED_KINEMATICS
       return
    end if
    call sf_int%reduce_momenta ([sqrt_x, sqrt_x])
  end subroutine escan_complete_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1392}Recover $x$.  The base procedure should return two momentum
fractions for the two beams, while we have only one parameter.  This
is the product of the extracted momentum fractions.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1393}\moddef{SF escan: escan: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: recover_x => escan_recover_x
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1394}\moddef{SF escan: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine escan_recover_x (sf_int, x, x_free)
    class(escan_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: x
    real(default), intent(inout), optional :: x_free
    real(default), dimension(2) :: xi
    call sf_int%base_recover_x (xi, x_free)
    x = product (xi)
  end subroutine escan_recover_x

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1395}Compute inverse kinematics.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1396}\moddef{SF escan: escan: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: inverse_kinematics => escan_inverse_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1397}\moddef{SF escan: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine escan_inverse_kinematics (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map, set_momenta)
    class(escan_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    logical, intent(in), optional :: set_momenta
    real(default) :: sqrt_x
    logical :: set_mom
    set_mom = .false.;  if (present (set_momenta))  set_mom = set_momenta
    sqrt_x = sqrt (x(1))
    if (sqrt_x > 0) then
       f = 1 / (2 * sqrt_x)
    else
       f = 0
       sf_int%status = SF_FAILED_KINEMATICS
       return
    end if
    r = x
    rb = 1 - r
    if (set_mom) then
       call sf_int%reduce_momenta ([sqrt_x, sqrt_x])
    end if
  end subroutine escan_inverse_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1398}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Energy scan application}
Here, we insert the predefined norm.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1399}\moddef{SF escan: escan: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: apply => escan_apply
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1400}\moddef{SF escan: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine escan_apply (sf_int, scale)
    class(escan_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), intent(in) :: scale
    real(default) :: f
    associate (data => sf_int%data)
      f = data%norm
    end associate
    call sf_int%set_matrix_element (cmplx (f, kind=default))
    sf_int%status = SF_EVALUATED
  end subroutine escan_apply

\eatline

Construct and display a test structure function data object.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1409}\moddef{SF escan: execute tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_escan_1, "sf_escan_1", &
       "structure function configuration", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1410}\moddef{SF escan: test declarations}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_escan_1
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1411}\moddef{SF escan: tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_escan_1 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2) :: pdg_in
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2) :: pdg_out
    integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: pdg1, pdg2
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable :: data

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_escan_1"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and display &
         &energy-scan structure function data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_qed_test ()
    pdg_in(1) = ELECTRON
    pdg_in(2) = -ELECTRON

    allocate (escan_data_t :: data)
    select type (data)
    type is (escan_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in, norm = 2._default)
    end select

    call data%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(1x,A)")  "Outgoing particle codes:"
    call data%get_pdg_out (pdg_out)
    pdg1 = pdg_out(1)
    pdg2 = pdg_out(2)
    write (u, "(2x,99(1x,I0))")  pdg1, pdg2

    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_escan_1"

  end subroutine sf_escan_1

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1412}g@
\subsubsection{Probe the structure-function object}
Active the beam event reader, generate an event.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1413}\moddef{SF escan: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_escan_2, "sf_escan_2", &
       "generate event", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1414}\moddef{SF escan: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_escan_2
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1415}\moddef{SF escan: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_escan_2 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(flavor_t), dimension(2) :: flv
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2) :: pdg_in
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable, target :: data
    class(sf_int_t), allocatable :: sf_int
    type(vector4_t) :: k1, k2
    real(default) :: E
    real(default), dimension(:), allocatable :: r, rb, x
    real(default) :: x_free, f

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_escan_2"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and display &
         &beam-events structure function data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_qed_test ()
    call flv(1)%init (ELECTRON, model)
    call flv(2)%init (-ELECTRON, model)
    pdg_in(1) = ELECTRON
    pdg_in(2) = -ELECTRON

    call reset_interaction_counter ()

    allocate (escan_data_t :: data)
    select type (data)
    type is (escan_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in)
    end select

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize structure-function object"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call data%allocate_sf_int (sf_int)
    call sf_int%init (data)
    call sf_int%set_beam_index ([1,2])

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize incoming momentum with E=500"
    write (u, "(A)")
    E = 250
    k1 = vector4_moving (E, sqrt (E**2 - flv(1)%get_mass ()**2), 3)
    k2 = vector4_moving (E,-sqrt (E**2 - flv(2)%get_mass ()**2), 3)
    call vector4_write (k1, u)
    call vector4_write (k2, u)
    call sf_int%seed_kinematics ([k1, k2])

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set dummy parameters and generate x"
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (r (data%get_n_par ()))
    allocate (rb(size (r)))
    allocate (x (size (r)))

    r  = 0.8
    rb = 1 - r
    x_free = 1

    call sf_int%complete_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.false.)

    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "r =", r
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "rb=", rb
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "xf=", x_free

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Inverse kinematics"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call sf_int%recover_x (x, x_free)
    call sf_int%inverse_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.false.)

    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "r =", r
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "rb=", rb
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "xf=", x_free

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Evaluate"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call sf_int%apply (scale = 0._default)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call sf_int%final ()
    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_escan_2"

  end subroutine sf_escan_2

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1416}%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\section{Gaussian beam spread}

Instead of an analytic beam description, beam data may be provided in
form of an event file.  In its most simple form, the event file
contains pairs of $x$ values, relative to nominal beam energies.  More
advanced formats may include polarization, etc.  The current
implementation carries beam polarization through, if specified.

The code is very similar to the energy scan described above.

However, we must include a file-handle manager for the beam-event
files.  Two different processes may access a given beam-event file at
the same time (i.e., serially but alternating).  Accessing an open
file from two different units is non-standard and not supported by all
compilers.  Therefore, we keep a global registry of open files,
associated units, and reference counts.  The {\Tt{}gaussian{\_}t\nwendquote} objects
act as proxies to this registry.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1417}\moddef{\code{}sf{\_}gaussian.f90\edoc{}}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
\LA{}File header\RA{}

module sf_gaussian

\LA{}Use kinds\RA{}
\LA{}Use strings\RA{}
  use io_units
  use format_defs, only: FMT_12
  use file_registries
  use diagnostics
  use lorentz
  use rng_base
  use pdg_arrays
  use model_data
  use flavors
  use quantum_numbers
  use state_matrices
  use polarizations
  use sf_base

\LA{}Standard module head\RA{}

\LA{}SF gaussian: public\RA{}

\LA{}SF gaussian: types\RA{}

contains

\LA{}SF gaussian: procedures\RA{}

end module sf_gaussian
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1418}\nwdocspar
\subsection{The beam-data file registry}
We manage data files via the {\Tt{}file{\_}registries\nwendquote} module.  To this end,
we keep the registry as a private module variable here.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1419}\moddef{CCC SF gaussian: variables}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type(file_registry_t), save :: beam_file_registry

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1420}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Data type}
We store the spread for each beam, as a relative number related to the beam
energy.  For the actual generation, we include an (abstract) random-number
generator factory.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1421}\moddef{SF gaussian: public}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: gaussian_data_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1422}\moddef{SF gaussian: types}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends(sf_data_t) :: gaussian_data_t
     private
     type(flavor_t), dimension(2) :: flv_in
     real(default), dimension(2) :: spread
     class(rng_factory_t), allocatable :: rng_factory
   contains
   \LA{}SF gaussian: gaussian data: TBP\RA{}
  end type gaussian_data_t

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1423} %def gaussian_data_t
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1424}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian data: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => gaussian_data_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1425}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine gaussian_data_init (data, model, pdg_in, spread, rng_factory)
    class(gaussian_data_t), intent(out) :: data
    class(model_data_t), intent(in), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2), intent(in) :: pdg_in
    real(default), dimension(2), intent(in) :: spread
    class(rng_factory_t), intent(inout), allocatable :: rng_factory
    if (any (spread < 0)) then
       call msg_fatal ("Gaussian beam spread: must not be negative")
    end if
    call data%flv_in(1)%init (pdg_array_get (pdg_in(1), 1), model)
    call data%flv_in(2)%init (pdg_array_get (pdg_in(2), 1), model)
    data%spread = spread
    call move_alloc (from = rng_factory, to = data%rng_factory)
  end subroutine gaussian_data_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1426}Return true since this spectrum is always in generator mode.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1427}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: is_generator => gaussian_data_is_generator
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1428}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function gaussian_data_is_generator (data) result (flag)
    class(gaussian_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    logical :: flag
    flag = .true.
  end function gaussian_data_is_generator

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1429}The number of parameters is two.  They are free parameters.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1430}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_n_par => gaussian_data_get_n_par
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1431}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function gaussian_data_get_n_par (data) result (n)
    class(gaussian_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer :: n
    n = 2
  end function gaussian_data_get_n_par

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1432}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_pdg_out => gaussian_data_get_pdg_out
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1433}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine gaussian_data_get_pdg_out (data, pdg_out)
    class(gaussian_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(:), intent(inout) :: pdg_out
    integer :: i, n
    n = 2
    do i = 1, n
       pdg_out(i) = data%flv_in(i)%get_pdg ()
    end do
  end subroutine gaussian_data_get_pdg_out

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1434}Allocate the interaction record.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1435}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: allocate_sf_int => gaussian_data_allocate_sf_int
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1436}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine gaussian_data_allocate_sf_int (data, sf_int)
    class(gaussian_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    class(sf_int_t), intent(inout), allocatable :: sf_int
    allocate (gaussian_t :: sf_int)
  end subroutine gaussian_data_allocate_sf_int

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1437}Output
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1438}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => gaussian_data_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1439}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine gaussian_data_write (data, unit, verbose)
    class(gaussian_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: verbose
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit);  if (u < 0)  return
    write (u, "(1x,A)") "Gaussian beam spread data:"
    write (u, "(3x,A,A,A,A)") "prt_in = ", &
         char (data%flv_in(1)%get_name ()), &
         ", ", char (data%flv_in(2)%get_name ())
    write (u, "(3x,A,2(1x," // FMT_12 // "))") "spread =", data%spread
    call data%rng_factory%write (u)
  end subroutine gaussian_data_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1440}\nwdocspar
\subsection{The gaussian object}
Flavor and polarization carried through, no radiated particles.  The generator
needs a random-number generator, obviously.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1441}\moddef{SF gaussian: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: gaussian_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1442}\moddef{SF gaussian: types}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends (sf_int_t) :: gaussian_t
     type(gaussian_data_t), pointer :: data => null ()
     class(rng_t), allocatable :: rng
   contains
   \LA{}SF gaussian: gaussian: TBP\RA{}
  end type gaussian_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1443}Type string: show gaussian file.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1444}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: type_string => gaussian_type_string
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1445}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function gaussian_type_string (object) result (string)
    class(gaussian_t), intent(in) :: object
    type(string_t) :: string
    if (associated (object%data)) then
       string = "Gaussian: gaussian beam-energy spread"
    else
       string = "Gaussian: [undefined]"
    end if
  end function gaussian_type_string

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1446}Output.  Call the interaction routine after displaying the configuration.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1447}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => gaussian_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1448}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine gaussian_write (object, unit, testflag)
    class(gaussian_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: testflag
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    if (associated (object%data)) then
       call object%data%write (u)
       call object%rng%write (u)
       call object%base_write (u, testflag)
    else
       write (u, "(1x,A)")  "gaussian data: [undefined]"
    end if
  end subroutine gaussian_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1449}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1450}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => gaussian_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1451}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine gaussian_init (sf_int, data)
    class(gaussian_t), intent(out) :: sf_int
    class(sf_data_t), intent(in), target :: data
    real(default), dimension(2) :: m2
    real(default), dimension(0) :: mr2
    type(quantum_numbers_mask_t), dimension(4) :: mask
    integer, dimension(4) :: hel_lock
    type(quantum_numbers_t), dimension(4) :: qn_fc, qn_hel, qn
    type(polarization_t), target :: pol1, pol2
    type(polarization_iterator_t) :: it_hel1, it_hel2
    integer :: i
    select type (data)
    type is (gaussian_data_t)
       m2 = data%flv_in%get_mass () ** 2
       hel_lock = [3, 4, 1, 2]
       mask = quantum_numbers_mask (.false., .false., .false.)
       call sf_int%base_init (mask, m2, mr2, m2, hel_lock = hel_lock)
       sf_int%data => data
       do i = 1, 2
          call qn_fc(i)%init ( &
               flv = data%flv_in(i), &
               col = color_from_flavor (data%flv_in(i)))
          call qn_fc(i+2)%init ( &
               flv = data%flv_in(i), &
               col = color_from_flavor (data%flv_in(i)))
       end do
       call pol1%init_generic (data%flv_in(1))
       call it_hel1%init (pol1)
       do while (it_hel1%is_valid ())
          qn_hel(1) = it_hel1%get_quantum_numbers ()
          qn_hel(3) = it_hel1%get_quantum_numbers ()
          call pol2%init_generic (data%flv_in(2))
          call it_hel2%init (pol2)
          do while (it_hel2%is_valid ())
             qn_hel(2) = it_hel2%get_quantum_numbers ()
             qn_hel(4) = it_hel2%get_quantum_numbers ()
             qn = qn_hel .merge. qn_fc
             call sf_int%add_state (qn)
             call it_hel2%advance ()
          end do
          ! call pol2%final ()
          call it_hel1%advance ()
       end do
       ! call pol1%final ()
       call sf_int%freeze ()
       call sf_int%set_incoming ([1,2])
       call sf_int%set_outgoing ([3,4])
       sf_int%status = SF_INITIAL
    end select
    call sf_int%data%rng_factory%make (sf_int%rng)
  end subroutine gaussian_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1452}This spectrum type needs a finalizer, which closes the data file.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1453}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: final => sf_gaussian_final
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1454}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_gaussian_final (object)
    class(gaussian_t), intent(inout) :: object
    call object%interaction_t%final ()
  end subroutine sf_gaussian_final

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1455}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Kinematics}
Refer to the {\Tt{}data\nwendquote} component.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1456}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: is_generator => gaussian_is_generator
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1457}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function gaussian_is_generator (sf_int) result (flag)
    class(gaussian_t), intent(in) :: sf_int
    logical :: flag
    flag = sf_int%data%is_generator ()
  end function gaussian_is_generator

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1458}Generate free parameters.  The $x$ value should be distributed with mean $1$
and $\sigma$ given by the spread.  We reject negative $x$ values.  (This
cut slightly biases the distribution, but for reasonable (small)
spreads negative $r$ should not occur.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1459}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: generate_free => gaussian_generate_free
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1460}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine gaussian_generate_free (sf_int, r, rb, x_free)
    class(gaussian_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: r, rb
    real(default), intent(inout) :: x_free
    real(default), dimension(size(r)) :: z
    associate (data => sf_int%data)
      do
         call sf_int%rng%generate_gaussian (z)
         rb = z * data%spread
         r = 1 - rb
         x_free = x_free * product (r)
         if (all (r > 0))  exit
      end do
    end associate
  end subroutine gaussian_generate_free

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1461}Set kinematics.  Trivial transfer since this is a pure generator.
The {\Tt{}map\nwendquote} flag doesn't apply.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1462}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: complete_kinematics => gaussian_complete_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1463}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine gaussian_complete_kinematics (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map)
    class(gaussian_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    if (map) then
       call msg_fatal ("gaussian: map flag not supported")
    else
       x = r
       f = 1
    end if
    call sf_int%reduce_momenta (x)
  end subroutine gaussian_complete_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1464}Compute inverse kinematics.  Trivial in this case.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1465}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: inverse_kinematics => gaussian_inverse_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1466}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine gaussian_inverse_kinematics &
       (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map, set_momenta)
    class(gaussian_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    logical, intent(in), optional :: set_momenta
    logical :: set_mom
    set_mom = .false.;  if (present (set_momenta))  set_mom = set_momenta
    if (map) then
       call msg_fatal ("gaussian: map flag not supported")
    else
       r = x
       f = 1
    end if
    rb = 1 - r
    if (set_mom) then
       call sf_int%reduce_momenta (x)
    end if
  end subroutine gaussian_inverse_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1467}\nwdocspar
\subsection{gaussian application}
Trivial, just set the unit weight.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1468}\moddef{SF gaussian: gaussian: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: apply => gaussian_apply
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1469}\moddef{SF gaussian: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine gaussian_apply (sf_int, scale)
    class(gaussian_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), intent(in) :: scale
    real(default) :: f
    f = 1
    call sf_int%set_matrix_element (cmplx (f, kind=default))
    sf_int%status = SF_EVALUATED
  end subroutine gaussian_apply

\eatline

\subsubsection{Test structure function data}
Construct and display a test structure function data object.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1478}\moddef{SF gaussian: execute tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_gaussian_1, "sf_gaussian_1", &
       "structure function configuration", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1479}\moddef{SF gaussian: test declarations}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_gaussian_1
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1480}\moddef{SF gaussian: tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_gaussian_1 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2) :: pdg_in
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2) :: pdg_out
    integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: pdg1, pdg2
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable :: data
    class(rng_factory_t), allocatable :: rng_factory

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_gaussian_1"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and display &
         &gaussian-spread structure function data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_qed_test ()
    pdg_in(1) = ELECTRON
    pdg_in(2) = -ELECTRON

    allocate (gaussian_data_t :: data)
    allocate (rng_test_factory_t :: rng_factory)
    select type (data)
    type is (gaussian_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in, [1e-2_default, 2e-2_default], rng_factory)
    end select

    call data%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(1x,A)")  "Outgoing particle codes:"
    call data%get_pdg_out (pdg_out)
    pdg1 = pdg_out(1)
    pdg2 = pdg_out(2)
    write (u, "(2x,99(1x,I0))")  pdg1, pdg2

    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_gaussian_1"

  end subroutine sf_gaussian_1

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1481}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Probe the structure-function object}
Active the beam event reader, generate an event.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1482}\moddef{SF gaussian: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_gaussian_2, "sf_gaussian_2", &
       "generate event", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1483}\moddef{SF gaussian: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_gaussian_2
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1484}\moddef{SF gaussian: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_gaussian_2 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(flavor_t), dimension(2) :: flv
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2) :: pdg_in
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable, target :: data
    class(rng_factory_t), allocatable :: rng_factory
    class(sf_int_t), allocatable :: sf_int
    type(vector4_t) :: k1, k2
    real(default) :: E
    real(default), dimension(:), allocatable :: r, rb, x
    real(default) :: x_free, f
    integer :: i

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_gaussian_2"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and display &
         &gaussian-spread structure function data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_qed_test ()
    call flv(1)%init (ELECTRON, model)
    call flv(2)%init (-ELECTRON, model)
    pdg_in(1) = ELECTRON
    pdg_in(2) = -ELECTRON

    call reset_interaction_counter ()

    allocate (gaussian_data_t :: data)
    allocate (rng_test_factory_t :: rng_factory)
    select type (data)
    type is (gaussian_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in, [1e-2_default, 2e-2_default], rng_factory)
    end select

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize structure-function object"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call data%allocate_sf_int (sf_int)
    call sf_int%init (data)
    call sf_int%set_beam_index ([1,2])

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize incoming momentum with E=500"
    write (u, "(A)")
    E = 250
    k1 = vector4_moving (E, sqrt (E**2 - flv(1)%get_mass ()**2), 3)
    k2 = vector4_moving (E,-sqrt (E**2 - flv(2)%get_mass ()**2), 3)
    call vector4_write (k1, u)
    call vector4_write (k2, u)
    call sf_int%seed_kinematics ([k1, k2])

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set dummy parameters and generate x."
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (r (data%get_n_par ()))
    allocate (rb(size (r)))
    allocate (x (size (r)))

    r  = 0
    rb = 0
    x_free = 1
    call sf_int%generate_free (r, rb, x_free)
    call sf_int%complete_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.false.)
    call pacify (rb, 1.e-8_default)

    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "r =", r
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "rb=", rb
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "xf=", x_free

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Evaluate"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call sf_int%apply (scale = 0._default)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Generate more events"
    write (u, "(A)")

    select type (sf_int)
    type is (gaussian_t)
       do i = 1, 3
          call sf_int%generate_free (r, rb, x_free)
          write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "r =", r
       end do
    end select

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call sf_int%final ()
    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_gaussian_2"

  end subroutine sf_gaussian_2

\eatline

\nwenddocs{}\nwbegindocs{1486}%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\section{Using beam event data}

Instead of an analytic beam description, beam data may be provided in
form of an event file.  In its most simple form, the event file
contains pairs of $x$ values, relative to nominal beam energies.  More
advanced formats may include polarization, etc.  The current
implementation carries beam polarization through, if specified.

The code is very similar to the energy scan described above.

However, we must include a file-handle manager for the beam-event
files.  Two different processes may access a given beam-event file at
the same time (i.e., serially but alternating).  Accessing an open
file from two different units is non-standard and not supported by all
compilers.  Therefore, we keep a global registry of open files,
associated units, and reference counts.  The {\Tt{}beam{\_}events{\_}t\nwendquote} objects
act as proxies to this registry.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1487}\moddef{\code{}sf{\_}beam{\_}events.f90\edoc{}}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
\LA{}File header\RA{}

\LA{}Use kinds\RA{}

  use file_registries
  use diagnostics
  use lorentz
  use pdg_arrays
  use model_data
  use flavors
  use quantum_numbers
  use state_matrices
  use polarizations
  use sf_base

\LA{}Standard module head\RA{}

\LA{}SF beam events: public\RA{}

\subsection{The beam-data file registry}
We manage data files via the {\Tt{}file{\_}registries\nwendquote} module.  To this end,
we keep the registry as a private module variable here.

This is public only for the unit tests.

\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1490}\moddef{SF beam events: variables}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1491}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Data type}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1492}\moddef{SF beam events: public}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: beam_events_data_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1493}\moddef{SF beam events: types}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  type, extends(sf_data_t) :: beam_events_data_t
     private
     type(flavor_t), dimension(2) :: flv_in
     type(string_t) :: dir
     type(string_t) :: file
     type(string_t) :: fqn
     integer :: unit = 0
     logical :: warn_eof = .true.
   contains
   \LA{}SF beam events: beam events data: TBP\RA{}
  end type beam_events_data_t

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1494} %def beam_events_data_t
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1495}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events data: TBP}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => beam_events_data_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1496}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine beam_events_data_init (data, model, pdg_in, dir, file, warn_eof)
    class(beam_events_data_t), intent(out) :: data
    class(model_data_t), intent(in), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2), intent(in) :: pdg_in
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: dir
    type(string_t), intent(in) :: file
    logical, intent(in), optional :: warn_eof
    if (any (pdg_array_get_length (pdg_in) /= 1)) then
       call msg_fatal ("Beam events: incoming beam particles must be unique")
    end if
    call data%flv_in(1)%init (pdg_array_get (pdg_in(1), 1), model)
    call data%flv_in(2)%init (pdg_array_get (pdg_in(2), 1), model)
    data%dir = dir
    data%file = file
    if (present (warn_eof))  data%warn_eof = warn_eof
  end subroutine beam_events_data_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1497}Return true since this spectrum is always in generator mode.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1498}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: is_generator => beam_events_data_is_generator
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1499}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function beam_events_data_is_generator (data) result (flag)
    class(beam_events_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    logical :: flag
    flag = .true.
  end function beam_events_data_is_generator

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1500}The number of parameters is two.  They are free parameters.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1501}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_n_par => beam_events_data_get_n_par
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1502}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function beam_events_data_get_n_par (data) result (n)
    class(beam_events_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer :: n
    n = 2
  end function beam_events_data_get_n_par

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1503}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: get_pdg_out => beam_events_data_get_pdg_out
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1504}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine beam_events_data_get_pdg_out (data, pdg_out)
    class(beam_events_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(:), intent(inout) :: pdg_out
    integer :: i, n
    n = 2
    do i = 1, n
       pdg_out(i) = data%flv_in(i)%get_pdg ()
    end do
  end subroutine beam_events_data_get_pdg_out

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1505}Allocate the interaction record.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1506}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: allocate_sf_int => beam_events_data_allocate_sf_int
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1507}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine beam_events_data_allocate_sf_int (data, sf_int)
    class(beam_events_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    class(sf_int_t), intent(inout), allocatable :: sf_int
    allocate (beam_events_t :: sf_int)
  end subroutine beam_events_data_allocate_sf_int

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1508}Output
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1509}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => beam_events_data_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1510}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine beam_events_data_write (data, unit, verbose)
    class(beam_events_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: verbose
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit);  if (u < 0)  return
    write (u, "(1x,A)") "Beam-event file data:"
    write (u, "(3x,A,A,A,A)") "prt_in = ", &
         char (data%flv_in(1)%get_name ()), &
         ", ", char (data%flv_in(2)%get_name ())
    write (u, "(3x,A,A,A)") "file   = '", char (data%file), "'"
    write (u, "(3x,A,I0)")  "unit   = ", data%unit
    write (u, "(3x,A,L1)")  "warn   = ", data%warn_eof
  end subroutine beam_events_data_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1511}The data file needs to be opened and closed explicitly.  The
open/close message is communicated to the file handle registry, which
does the actual work.

We determine first whether to look in the local directory or in the
given system directory.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1512}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: open => beam_events_data_open
  procedure :: close => beam_events_data_close
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1513}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine beam_events_data_open (data)
    class(beam_events_data_t), intent(inout) :: data
    logical :: exist
    if (data%unit == 0) then
       data%fqn = data%file
       if (data%fqn == "") &
            call msg_fatal ("Beam events: $beam_events_file is not set")
       inquire (file = char (data%fqn), exist = exist)
       if (.not. exist) then
          data%fqn = data%dir // "/" // data%file
          inquire (file = char (data%fqn), exist = exist)
          if (.not. exist) then
             data%fqn = ""
             call msg_fatal ("Beam events: file '" &
                  // char (data%file) // "' not found")
             return
          end if
       end if
       call msg_message ("Beam events: reading from file '" &
            // char (data%file) // "'")
       call beam_file_registry%open (data%fqn, data%unit)
    else
       call msg_bug ("Beam events: file '" &
         // char (data%file) // "' is already open")
    end if
  end subroutine beam_events_data_open

  subroutine beam_events_data_close (data)
    class(beam_events_data_t), intent(inout) :: data
    if (data%unit /= 0) then
       call beam_file_registry%close (data%fqn)
       call msg_message ("Beam events: closed file '" &
         // char (data%file) // "'")
       data%unit = 0
    end if
  end subroutine beam_events_data_close

\eatline

\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1515}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events data: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup

    class(beam_events_data_t), intent(in) :: data
    type(string_t) :: file
    file = "Beam events: " // data%file
  end function beam_events_data_get_beam_file

\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1524}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: write => beam_events_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1525}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine beam_events_write (object, unit, testflag)
    class(beam_events_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: testflag
    integer :: u
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    if (associated (object%data)) then
       call object%data%write (u)
       call object%base_write (u, testflag)
    else
       write (u, "(1x,A)")  "Beam events data: [undefined]"
    end if
  end subroutine beam_events_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1526}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1527}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: init => beam_events_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1528}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine beam_events_init (sf_int, data)
    class(beam_events_t), intent(out) :: sf_int
    class(sf_data_t), intent(in), target :: data
    real(default), dimension(2) :: m2
    real(default), dimension(0) :: mr2
    type(quantum_numbers_mask_t), dimension(4) :: mask
    integer, dimension(4) :: hel_lock
    type(quantum_numbers_t), dimension(4) :: qn_fc, qn_hel, qn
    type(polarization_t), target :: pol1, pol2
    type(polarization_iterator_t) :: it_hel1, it_hel2
    integer :: i
    select type (data)
    type is (beam_events_data_t)
       m2 = data%flv_in%get_mass () ** 2
       hel_lock = [3, 4, 1, 2]
       mask = quantum_numbers_mask (.false., .false., .false.)
       call sf_int%base_init (mask, m2, mr2, m2, hel_lock = hel_lock)
       sf_int%data => data
       do i = 1, 2
          call qn_fc(i)%init ( &
               flv = data%flv_in(i), &
               col = color_from_flavor (data%flv_in(i)))
          call qn_fc(i+2)%init ( &
               flv = data%flv_in(i), &
               col = color_from_flavor (data%flv_in(i)))
       end do
       call pol1%init_generic (data%flv_in(1))
       call it_hel1%init (pol1)
       do while (it_hel1%is_valid ())
          qn_hel(1) = it_hel1%get_quantum_numbers ()
          qn_hel(3) = it_hel1%get_quantum_numbers ()
          call pol2%init_generic (data%flv_in(2))
          call it_hel2%init (pol2)
          do while (it_hel2%is_valid ())
             qn_hel(2) = it_hel2%get_quantum_numbers ()
             qn_hel(4) = it_hel2%get_quantum_numbers ()
             qn = qn_hel .merge. qn_fc
             call sf_int%add_state (qn)
             call it_hel2%advance ()
          end do
          ! call pol2%final ()
          call it_hel1%advance ()
       end do
       ! call pol1%final ()
       call sf_int%freeze ()
       call sf_int%set_incoming ([1,2])
       call sf_int%set_outgoing ([3,4])
       call sf_int%data%open ()
       sf_int%status = SF_INITIAL
    end select
  end subroutine beam_events_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1529}This spectrum type needs a finalizer, which closes the data file.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1530}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: final => sf_beam_events_final
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1531}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_beam_events_final (object)
    class(beam_events_t), intent(inout) :: object
    call object%data%close ()
    call object%interaction_t%final ()
  end subroutine sf_beam_events_final

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1532}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Kinematics}
Refer to the {\Tt{}data\nwendquote} component.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1533}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: is_generator => beam_events_is_generator
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1534}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  function beam_events_is_generator (sf_int) result (flag)
    class(beam_events_t), intent(in) :: sf_int
    logical :: flag
    flag = sf_int%data%is_generator ()
  end function beam_events_is_generator

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1535}Generate free parameters.  We read them from file.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1536}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: generate_free => beam_events_generate_free
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1537}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  recursive subroutine beam_events_generate_free (sf_int, r, rb,  x_free)
    class(beam_events_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: r, rb
    real(default), intent(inout) :: x_free
    integer :: iostat
    associate (data => sf_int%data)
      if (data%unit /= 0) then
         read (data%unit, fmt=*, iostat=iostat)  r
         if (iostat > 0) then
            write (msg_buffer, "(A,I0,A)") &
                 "Beam events: I/O error after reading ", sf_int%count, &
                 " events"
            call msg_fatal ()
         else if (iostat < 0) then
            if (sf_int%count == 0) then
               call msg_fatal ("Beam events: file is empty")
            else if (sf_int%data%warn_eof) then
               write (msg_buffer, "(A,I0,A)") &
                    "Beam events: End of file after reading ", sf_int%count, &
                    " events, rewinding"
               call msg_warning ()
            end if
            rewind (data%unit)
            sf_int%count = 0
            call sf_int%generate_free (r, rb, x_free)
         else
            sf_int%count = sf_int%count + 1
            rb = 1 - r
            x_free = x_free * product (r)
         end if
      else
         call msg_bug ("Beam events: file is not open for reading")
      end if
    end associate
  end subroutine beam_events_generate_free

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1538}Set kinematics.  Trivial transfer since this is a pure generator.
The {\Tt{}map\nwendquote} flag doesn't apply.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1539}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: complete_kinematics => beam_events_complete_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1540}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine beam_events_complete_kinematics (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map)
    class(beam_events_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    if (map) then
       call msg_fatal ("Beam events: map flag not supported")
    else
       x = r
       f = 1
    end if
    call sf_int%reduce_momenta (x)
  end subroutine beam_events_complete_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1541}Compute inverse kinematics.  Trivial in this case.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1542}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: inverse_kinematics => beam_events_inverse_kinematics
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1543}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine beam_events_inverse_kinematics &
       (sf_int, x, f, r, rb, map, set_momenta)
    class(beam_events_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(in) :: x
    real(default), intent(out) :: f
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: r
    real(default), dimension(:), intent(out) :: rb
    logical, intent(in) :: map
    logical, intent(in), optional :: set_momenta
    logical :: set_mom
    set_mom = .false.;  if (present (set_momenta))  set_mom = set_momenta
    if (map) then
       call msg_fatal ("Beam events: map flag not supported")
    else
       r = x
       f = 1
    end if
    rb = 1 - r
    if (set_mom) then
       call sf_int%reduce_momenta (x)
    end if
  end subroutine beam_events_inverse_kinematics

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1544}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Beam events application}
Trivial, just set the unit weight.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1545}\moddef{SF beam events: beam events: TBP}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  procedure :: apply => beam_events_apply
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1546}\moddef{SF beam events: procedures}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine beam_events_apply (sf_int, scale)
    class(beam_events_t), intent(inout) :: sf_int
    real(default), intent(in) :: scale
    real(default) :: f
    f = 1
    call sf_int%set_matrix_element (cmplx (f, kind=default))
    sf_int%status = SF_EVALUATED
  end subroutine beam_events_apply

\subsubsection{Test structure function data}
Construct and display a test structure function data object.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1555}\moddef{SF beam events: execute tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_beam_events_1, "sf_beam_events_1", &
       "structure function configuration", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1556}\moddef{SF beam events: test declarations}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_beam_events_1
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1557}\moddef{SF beam events: tests}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_beam_events_1 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2) :: pdg_in
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2) :: pdg_out
    integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: pdg1, pdg2
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable :: data

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_beam_events_1"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and display &
         &beam-events structure function data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_qed_test ()
    pdg_in(1) = ELECTRON
    pdg_in(2) = -ELECTRON

    allocate (beam_events_data_t :: data)
    select type (data)
    type is (beam_events_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in, var_str (""), var_str ("beam_events.dat"))
    end select

    call data%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(1x,A)")  "Outgoing particle codes:"
    call data%get_pdg_out (pdg_out)
    pdg1 = pdg_out(1)
    pdg2 = pdg_out(2)
    write (u, "(2x,99(1x,I0))")  pdg1, pdg2

    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_beam_events_1"

  end subroutine sf_beam_events_1

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1558}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Probe the structure-function object}
Active the beam event reader, generate an event.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1559}\moddef{SF beam events: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_beam_events_2, "sf_beam_events_2", &
       "generate event", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1560}\moddef{SF beam events: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_beam_events_2
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1561}\moddef{SF beam events: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_beam_events_2 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type(model_data_t), target :: model
    type(flavor_t), dimension(2) :: flv
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(2) :: pdg_in
    class(sf_data_t), allocatable, target :: data
    class(sf_int_t), allocatable :: sf_int
    type(vector4_t) :: k1, k2
    real(default) :: E
    real(default), dimension(:), allocatable :: r, rb, x
    real(default) :: x_free, f
    integer :: i

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_beam_events_2"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: initialize and display &
         &beam-events structure function data"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call model%init_qed_test ()
    call flv(1)%init (ELECTRON, model)
    call flv(2)%init (-ELECTRON, model)
    pdg_in(1) = ELECTRON
    pdg_in(2) = -ELECTRON

    call reset_interaction_counter ()

    allocate (beam_events_data_t :: data)
    select type (data)
    type is (beam_events_data_t)
       call data%init (model, pdg_in, &
            var_str (""), var_str ("test_beam_events.dat"))
    end select

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize structure-function object"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call data%allocate_sf_int (sf_int)
    call sf_int%init (data)
    call sf_int%set_beam_index ([1,2])

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Initialize incoming momentum with E=500"
    write (u, "(A)")
    E = 250
    k1 = vector4_moving (E, sqrt (E**2 - flv(1)%get_mass ()**2), 3)
    k2 = vector4_moving (E,-sqrt (E**2 - flv(2)%get_mass ()**2), 3)
    call vector4_write (k1, u)
    call vector4_write (k2, u)
    call sf_int%seed_kinematics ([k1, k2])

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Set dummy parameters and generate x."
    write (u, "(A)")

    allocate (r (data%get_n_par ()))
    allocate (rb(size (r)))
    allocate (x (size (r)))

    r  = 0
    rb = 0
    x_free = 1
    call sf_int%generate_free (r, rb, x_free)
    call sf_int%complete_kinematics (x, f, r, rb, map=.false.)

    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "r =", r
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "rb=", rb
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "x =", x
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "f =", f
    write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "xf=", x_free
    select type (sf_int)
    type is (beam_events_t)
       write (u, "(A,1x,I0)")  "count =", sf_int%count
    end select

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Evaluate"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call sf_int%apply (scale = 0._default)
    call sf_int%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Generate more events, rewind"
    write (u, "(A)")

    select type (sf_int)
    type is (beam_events_t)
       do i = 1, 3
          call sf_int%generate_free (r, rb, x_free)
          write (u, "(A,9(1x,F10.7))")  "r =", r
          write (u, "(A,1x,I0)")  "count =", sf_int%count
       end do
    end select

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    call sf_int%final ()
    call model%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_beam_events_2"

  end subroutine sf_beam_events_2

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1562}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Check the file handle registry}
Open and close some files, checking the registry contents.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1563}\moddef{SF beam events: execute tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  call test (sf_beam_events_3, "sf_beam_events_3", &
       "check registry", &
       u, results)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1564}\moddef{SF beam events: test declarations}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  public :: sf_beam_events_3
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{1565}\moddef{SF beam events: tests}\plusendmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
  subroutine sf_beam_events_3 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    integer :: u1

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: sf_beam_events_2"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: check file handle registry"
    write (u, "(A)")

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Create some empty files"
    write (u, "(A)")

    u1 = free_unit ()
    open (u1, file = "sf_beam_events_f1.tmp", action="write", status="new")
    close (u1)
    open (u1, file = "sf_beam_events_f2.tmp", action="write", status="new")
    close (u1)
    open (u1, file = "sf_beam_events_f3.tmp", action="write", status="new")
    close (u1)

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Empty registry"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call beam_file_registry%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Insert three entries"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call beam_file_registry%open (var_str ("sf_beam_events_f3.tmp"))
    call beam_file_registry%open (var_str ("sf_beam_events_f2.tmp"))
    call beam_file_registry%open (var_str ("sf_beam_events_f1.tmp"))
    call beam_file_registry%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Open a second channel"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call beam_file_registry%open (var_str ("sf_beam_events_f2.tmp"))
    call beam_file_registry%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Close second entry twice"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call beam_file_registry%close (var_str ("sf_beam_events_f2.tmp"))
    call beam_file_registry%close (var_str ("sf_beam_events_f2.tmp"))
    call beam_file_registry%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Close last entry"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call beam_file_registry%close (var_str ("sf_beam_events_f3.tmp"))
    call beam_file_registry%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Close remaining entry"
    write (u, "(A)")

    call beam_file_registry%close (var_str ("sf_beam_events_f1.tmp"))
    call beam_file_registry%write (u)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"

    open (u1, file = "sf_beam_events_f1.tmp", action="write")
    close (u1, status = "delete")
    open (u1, file = "sf_beam_events_f2.tmp", action="write")
    close (u1, status = "delete")
    open (u1, file = "sf_beam_events_f3.tmp", action="write")
    close (u1, status = "delete")

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: sf_beam_events_3"

  end subroutine sf_beam_events_3

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{1566}\nwdocspar

%------------------------------------------------------------------------
\section{Lepton collider beamstrahlung: CIRCE1}

\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{1567}\moddef{\code{}sf{\_}circe1.f90\edoc{}}\endmoddef\nwstartdeflinemarkup\nwenddeflinemarkup
\LA{}File header\RA{}

module sf_circe1

\LA{}Use kinds\RA{}
  use kinds, only: double
\LA{}Use strings\RA{}
  use io_units
  use format_defs, only: FMT_17, FMT_19
  use diagnostics
  use physics_defs, only: ELECTRON, PHOTON
  use lorentz
  use rng_base
  use pdg_arrays
  use model_data
  use flavors
  use colors
  use quantum_numbers
  use state_matrices
  use polarizations
  use sf_mappings
  use sf_base
  use circe1, circe1_rng_t => rng_type !NODEP!

\LA{}Standard module head\RA{}

\LA{}SF circe1: public\RA{}

\LA{}SF circe1: types\RA{}

contains

\LA{}SF circe1: procedures\RA{}
